items.title: 美銀警告Fed利率恐破5%！短債殖利率仍有上行空間
items.title_en: Bank of America Warns Fed Rates May Break 5%—Short-Term Treasury Yields Still Have Upside
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)本週重啟升息後，市場對升息終點的分歧擴大。美國銀行策略師近日指出，政策利率有升破5%的風險，短天期美債殖利率仍有上行空間。
據媒體當地時間週五報導，美銀策略師表示，投資人應開始為聯準會將基準利率上調至5%以上的風險做好準備。
美銀策略師Mark Cabana、Meghan Swiber及其團隊認為，利率市場仍低估了聯準會升息週期的終點，建議客戶布局兩年期美債殖利率上行。
目前，利率掉期市場定價顯示，聯準會還將再升息三次、每次25個基點，屆時聯邦基金利率將升至4.5%至4.75%區間。
而美銀策略師認為，聯邦基金利率有可能重回2022年至2023年升息週期的高點。彼時，聯邦基金目標利率上限一度達到5.5%。
該團隊的判斷基於多項依據：一方面，聯準會最新發布的經濟預測摘要（SEP）顯示，官員們認為通膨面臨的上行風險遠大於失業率面臨的上行風險。
另一方面，根據一項泰勒規則的測算，聯邦基金利率應在5.3%左右。
泰勒規則由史丹佛大學經濟學家約翰・泰勒（John Taylor）於1993年提出。該規則根據通膨和經濟產出偏離目標水準的程度，推算出建議的政策利率，是市場廣泛參考的貨幣政策框架之一。
美銀策略師的上述判斷，也比美銀內部經濟學家團隊更為鷹派。上述策略師團隊負責覆蓋債券市場並為客戶挖掘交易機會，與專注研究聯準會政策的經濟學家團隊相互獨立。
美銀經濟學家Aditya Bhave在週三發布的報告中表示，其團隊維持今年還將升息兩次的預測，時間分別為10月和12月，並預計2027年不會有進一步的政策行動。
在殖利率方面，Mark Cabana、Meghan Swiber團隊預計，兩年期美債殖利率年內將升至5%，高於目前約4.7%的水準。
策略師認為，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)最新表態為這項判斷提供了支撐。華許表示，9月16日的升息收回了「一定程度的寬鬆」。在策略師看來，這表明聯準會官員尚不認為當前貨幣政策已對美國經濟形成抑制。
策略師報告寫道：「一個不認為政策具有限制性的聯準會，很可能會持續升息，直至金融環境轉為限制性。這增強了我們對殖利率曲線趨平的信心。」
報導指出，近幾個交易日，隨著交易員加碼押注聯準會進一步升息，美債殖利率曲線趨於平坦，短端殖利率漲幅超過長端。
策略師指出，儘管短端殖利率可能繼續上升，但預計其向更長期限的傳導將較為有限。他們預計，10年期美債殖利率今年年底將收於5%。
paras_en: After the Fed resumed rate hikes this week, market disagreement over the end point widened. Bank of America strategists recently noted that policy rates could rise above 5%, and short-term U.S. Treasury yields still have room to climb.
According to media reports on Friday, BofA strategists said investors should start preparing for the risk that the Fed could lift its benchmark rate above 5%.

BofA strategists Mark Cabana, Meghan Swiber, and their team believe that the rate market still underestimates the Fed’s rate‑cutting cycle end, and they advise clients to position for a rise in the two‑year Treasury yield.
Currently, the interest‑rate swap market pricing indicates that the Fed will raise rates three more times, each by 25 basis points, bringing the federal funds rate to a 4.5%‑4.75% range.
BofA strategists think the federal funds rate could return to the high points of the 2022‑2023 rate‑cutting cycle, when the upper limit of the federal funds target rate once reached 5.5%.

Their assessment is based on several factors: on one hand, the Fed’s latest Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) shows that officials view inflation’s upside risk as far greater than the upside risk of unemployment.
On the other hand, a calculation using the Taylor rule suggests the federal funds rate should be around 5.3%.

The Taylor rule, proposed by Stanford economist John Taylor in 1993, estimates the recommended policy rate based on the degree of inflation and output gap relative to target levels, and is one of the widely referenced monetary policy frameworks.

BofA strategists’ view is more hawkish than the bank’s internal economic research team. The strategist team covers the bond market and seeks trading opportunities for clients, operating independently from the economists focused on Fed policy.

BofA economist Aditya Bhave, in a report released on Wednesday, said his team maintains a forecast of two more rate hikes this year, scheduled for October and December, and expects no further policy action in 2027.
Regarding yields, Cabana and Swiber’s team anticipate the two‑year Treasury yield will rise to 5% this year, above the current level of about 4.7%.

The strategists believe Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s latest statement supports this view. Warsh said the September 16 rate hike “recovered a certain degree of looseness.” In the strategists’ view, this indicates Fed officials do not yet see current monetary policy as restraining the U.S. economy.

The report states: “A Fed that does not see policy as restrictive is likely to keep raising rates until the financial environment becomes restrictive. This strengthens our confidence in a flattening yield curve.”
The report notes that in recent trading days, as traders increased bets on further Fed hikes, the Treasury yield curve has flattened, with short‑end yields rising more than long‑end yields.

The strategists point out that although short‑end yields may continue to rise, the transmission to longer maturities is expected to be more limited. They forecast the 10‑year Treasury yield to close at 5% by year‑end.

items.title: 央行不跟進聯準會升息、台積電除息秀、華邦電收購英飛凌記憶體事業 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Central Bank Doesn't Follow Fed Rate Hike, TSMC Dividend, Winbond Acquires Infineon's Memory Business – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美國聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息1碼，台灣央行則不跟進，利率連10凍；台積電周三除息，當日即完成填息；華邦電周三宣布，以356億元收購英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈央行理監事會〉利率連10凍、對房市鬆綁 楊金龍不跟進美國升息：走自己的路 

儘管美國聯準會甫宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，台灣是否跟進引發國內各界討論，但台灣央行周四 (17日) 召開第三季理監事會議，仍宣布利率「連 10 凍」，央行總裁楊金龍說，「我們走我們的路」；同時，此次央行放鬆對房市的選擇性信用管制措施，調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成。

台積電除息7元 填息後攻上2400元

台積電(2330-TW)周三(16日)進行除息，每股配發現金股利7元，除息參考價為2378元，當天盤中完成填息後，一路走高，周五以2460元作收，順利展開填息行情。台積電自2019年改採季配息以來，歷次除息均順利完成填息，當中更有22次於除息當日填息完畢，加上今日紀錄，共有23次於除息當日填息完畢。

華邦電砸356億元收購英飛凌記憶體事業 Spansion品牌復活 

華邦電(2344-TW)周三(16日)召開重訊記者會宣布海外併購案，與英飛凌旗下Infineon Technologies LLC簽署股份購買協議，以全現金方式取得英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，基礎交易價格達11.2億美元，折合新台幣約356.23億元，預計2027年下半年完成交易，收購完畢後，標的公司將以「Spansion」為名，延續該品牌價值。

大立光再砸11.72億元購入台中精密機械園區土地廠房 

光學元件廠大立光 (3008-TW)繼在台中工業區購地接連出手後，並在精密機械園區持續購地，大立光周四(17日)公布以11.72億元在精密機械園區內取得產業用不動產，賣方爲台灣固而美工業。

SOGO大巨蛋商場今開幕 遠東徐國安到場喊拚零售創新 

遠東SOGO大巨蛋商場Garden City周三(16日)正式開幕，董事長黃晴雯表示，試營運至今近一個月，業績較預期高出2成，全年業績有望達百億元目標，儘管緊鄰東區商圈和既有的忠孝SOGO和復興SOGO，客源並未受排擠，反而大巨蛋商場有效為SOGO導入更多年輕客源。

電價續凍漲！審議會拍板優先爭取政府711億補助 費率延至12月併審 

經濟部周五(18日)召開115年第2次電價費率審議會，會後記者會由次長賴建信主持。審議委員會指出，影響本期電價的主因為中東戰事，國際燃料價格大漲導致發購電成本大幅攀升，為避免引發國內物價波動，會議決議支持優先爭取政府撥補預算711億元，因此本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議輸配電費率時再行討論，意味著最快調漲電價的時間點將落在明年1月。

物價破2%免驚！葉俊顯估今年GDP挑戰「摸到12%」溫和通膨如健康體溫將成常態 

對近期國際經濟情勢與台灣整體經濟展望，國發會主委葉俊顯周二(15日)受訪時展現高度樂觀態度。針對市場擔憂國際油價波動及 AI 技術發展可能放緩等變數，葉俊顯明確指出，台灣經濟基本面極具韌性，在今年全年 GDP 成長率在出口強勁堆疊下，有機會進一步衝刺「摸到 12%」的新高點。他並強調未來溫和通膨將如「健康體溫」，不見得一定在2%以下，有時壓得太低反對經濟不健康。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced a 0.25 percentage point rate hike on Wednesday (the 16th), but Taiwan's central bank did not follow suit, keeping rates frozen for the tenth consecutive meeting; TSMC declared a dividend on Wednesday and completed the price recovery the same day; Winbond announced on Wednesday that it will acquire 100% of Infineon's NOR Flash and related memory business for NT$35.6 billion. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

At the central bank’s board meeting on Thursday (the 17th), the bank announced that interest rates remain frozen for the tenth straight meeting, with Governor Yang Jin‑long saying “we are walking our own path.” At the same time, the bank relaxed selective credit controls on the housing market, raising the maximum loan‑to‑value ratio for a buyer’s second home from 60% to 70%.

TSMC (2330‑TW) went ex‑dividend on Wednesday (the 16th), distributing a cash dividend of NT$7 per share. The ex‑dividend reference price was NT$2,378. After the dividend was filled in during the same trading session, the stock rose and closed at NT$2,460 on Friday, successfully completing the dividend‑fill rally. Since switching to quarterly dividends in 2019, TSMC has always filled the dividend on the ex‑date, achieving this on the day of the ex‑dividend 23 times, including today.

Winbond (2344‑TW) held a major press conference on Wednesday (the 16th) to announce an overseas acquisition. It signed a share purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon, to acquire 100% of the NOR Flash and related memory business for cash. The base transaction price is US$1.12 billion, roughly NT$35.623 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2027. After the acquisition, the target will operate under the “Spansion” brand to preserve its brand value.

Largan Precision (3008‑TW) continued its land‑buying spree after earlier purchases in the Taichung industrial zone. On Thursday (the 17th) it announced a NT$1.172 billion purchase of industrial‑use real estate in the Precision Machinery Park, buying the property from Taiwan’s Guremei Industrial.

Far Eastern SOGO’s Grand Arena Mall, Garden City, officially opened on Wednesday (the 16th). Chairman Huang Qing‑wen said that after nearly a month of trial operation, performance is about 20% higher than expected, and the mall is on track to reach a NT$100 billion annual target. Despite being adjacent to the East District commercial area and existing SOGO locations in Zhongxiao and Fuxing, the new mall has not cannibalized traffic; instead, it has attracted more young shoppers to SOGO.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs held the second 2023 electricity‑price review meeting on Friday (the 18th). The committee noted that the main driver of the current price review is the Middle‑East conflict, which has pushed international fuel prices sharply higher and raised power‑generation costs. To avoid domestic price volatility, the meeting voted to prioritize securing a NT$71.1 billion government subsidy, leaving the current price adjustment undecided until it is reconsidered with transmission‑and‑distribution rates at the third review meeting in December, meaning the earliest possible rate hike would be in January 2024.

National Development Council Chairman Yeh Jun‑hsian expressed strong optimism on Tuesday (the 15th) about Taiwan’s economic outlook despite recent global uncertainties. He said that Taiwan’s economy is resilient and, with strong export momentum, could push full‑year GDP growth toward a “touch‑12%” target. He also emphasized that moderate inflation, akin to a healthy body temperature, does not have to stay below 2%; keeping it too low could hinder a healthy economy.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉癌症疫苗重大突破 基因免疫主題ETF 00898、00897強勢攻高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Major Breakthrough in Cancer Vaccine Boosts Gene Immunity ETFs 00898 and 00897
paras: 受惠於國際生技巨頭在個人化 mRNA 癌症疫苗臨床試驗取得歷史性突破，於台股掛牌的相關海外生技 ETF 展現強勁爆發力。其中，國泰基因免疫革命(00898-TW)本周市價大漲 8.65%，18 日收在 11.43 元，創掛牌以來新高；富邦基因免疫生技(00897-TW) 亦不甘示弱，周漲幅達 6.36%，收在 13.37 元。兩檔聚焦前沿基因與免疫療法的 ETF 雙雙成為市場焦點。
市場法人分析，本次生技族群強勢發動的主因，源於生技大廠莫德納(Moderna)與默克(Merck)共同宣布其個人化 mRNA 癌症疫苗(INTerpath-001)第三期臨床試驗成果輝煌。試驗數據顯示，該療法能顯著延長黑色素瘤患者術後的「無復發存活期」與「無遠端轉移存活期」。
這項結果證實了 mRNA 技術成功從傳統傳染病防護擴展至精準腫瘤治療，開闢了龐大的新藥商業化空間，激勵莫德納股價強勢噴發，並直接帶動全球基因醫療供應鏈與概念股全面狂歡。
由於國泰 00898 與富邦 00897 均選入高度聚焦基因編輯、免疫細胞療法與精準診斷的指標企業，產業純度極高，因而成為這波生技股重估行情的最大受惠者。
富邦 00897 第一大持股即為莫德納，權重高達 8.73%，搭配其布局默克權重 3.61% 及 Regeneron、Vertex 等大型藥廠，此外，Revolution Medicines (RVMD-US) 等標靶 RAS 突變癌症新藥研發公司亦獲得資金追捧。00897 本周累計漲幅6.36%。
國泰 00898 持股重心則更加彈性且多元，前三大持股包括 Iovance Biotherapeutics(5.12%)、GeneDx(5.04%)與 Twist Bioscience(4.52%)，同時涵蓋莫德納與癌症基因檢測大廠 Natera、Guardant Health 等，在中小型標的衝刺下，本周彈升力道更為猛烈，漲幅達8.65%。
法人指出，由於基因編輯、精準檢測與癌症疫苗具備不可替代的技術壁壘，且 9 月中旬歐洲腫瘤醫學會(ESMO)公布多項突破性臨床數據，吸引避險與成長型資金逆勢回流。在 AI 製藥與新藥商業化加速的背景下，基因免疫主題仍將是中長期資金配置的焦點。

paras_en: Benefiting from a historic breakthrough in personalized mRNA cancer vaccine trials by international biotech giants, related overseas biotech ETFs listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange showed strong explosive performance. Cathay Gene Immunity Revolution (00898‑TW) surged 8.65% this week, closing at NT$11.43 on the 18th, a new high since its listing; Fubon Gene Immunity Biotech (00897‑TW) was not far behind, up 6.36% for the week and closing at NT$13.37. Both ETFs, which focus on cutting‑edge gene and immunotherapy, became market focal points.

Market analysts attribute the biotech sector’s rally to the joint announcement by Moderna and Merck that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine (INTerpath‑001) achieved spectacular results in Phase III trials. The data showed the therapy significantly extended both disease‑free survival and distant‑metastasis‑free survival for post‑surgery melanoma patients.

The outcome confirms that mRNA technology can successfully expand from traditional infectious‑disease protection to precision oncology, opening a huge commercial drug space, spurring Moderna’s stock to rally and driving a broad celebration across the global gene‑therapy supply chain and related concept stocks.

Because both Cathay 00898 and Fubon 00897 select highly focused companies in gene editing, cell‑based immunotherapy and precision diagnostics, their portfolio purity is extremely high, making them the biggest beneficiaries of this biotech re‑valuation wave.

Fubon 00897’s top holding is Moderna, accounting for 8.73% of the fund, complemented by a 3.61% stake in Merck and positions in large pharma such as Regeneron and Vertex. It also attracted capital to target‑focused RAS‑mutation cancer drug developers like Revolution Medicines (RVMD‑US). The fund posted a cumulative weekly gain of 6.36%.

Cathay 00898’s holdings are more flexible and diversified, with the three largest positions being Iovance Biotherapeutics (5.12%), GeneDx (5.04%) and Twist Bioscience (4.52%). It also includes Moderna and major cancer‑genomics players Natera and Guardant Health, and the surge in small‑ and mid‑cap targets drove a sharper weekly rise of 8.65%.

Analysts note that gene editing, precision testing and cancer vaccines have irreplaceable technical barriers, and that the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) released multiple breakthrough clinical data in mid‑September, attracting defensive and growth capital back into the sector. Amid accelerating AI‑driven drug discovery and drug commercialization, the gene‑immunity theme will remain a focal point for medium‑ to long‑term fund allocation.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗清車用、AI領域雙布局 周漲逾1成回升至2個月來高價
items.title_en: Hot Stocks: Liching Targets Automotive and AI Sectors, Weekly Rise Over 10% Returns to Two-Month High
paras: 車用零組件廠麗清(3346-TW)本周股價反彈12%，回升至2個月來糕點，反映8月合併營收衝上近16個月高點，麗清表示，墨西哥新廠預計自下半年開始量產出貨，而布局AI領域也推進，機器人關節的控制模組產品已陸續進入小量出貨階段。
麗清指出，華域視覺、海拉、廣州小糸等主要Tier 1客戶對LED車燈模組備貨需求持續增溫，加上特斯拉平價車款、小米SUV等新車款訂單於第三季起陸續進入量產階段，帶動出貨逐步增加。
同時，麗清墨西哥新廠預計自下半年開始量產出貨，提升在北美市場的在地供應能力，而泰國新廠也於下半年推進投入生產行列。
除車用本業營運逐步成長外，麗清旗下應用於機器人關節控制控制模組產品，已陸續進入小量出貨階段，目前仍持續與客戶推進新專案研發與產品規格優化，拚為中長期營運打造第二成長曲線。
展望下半年，麗清維持審慎樂觀，隨著新車款訂單陸續進入量產出貨，預期車用LED產品及頭燈控制器出貨表現可望維持穩健，而隨著墨西哥、泰國新廠陸續投入量產，在北美及東南亞供應鏈布局將更趨完善；另一方面，機器人關節控制模組出貨動能持續累積，強化中長期營運韌性與成長動能。
paras_en: Automotive component maker Liching (3346‑TW) saw its stock rebound 12% this week, climbing back to a two‑month high, reflecting August consolidated revenue hitting a near 16‑month peak. Liching said its new plant in Mexico is slated to start mass production and shipments in the second half of the year, and its AI‑related push is advancing, with robot‑joint control module products now entering a small‑scale shipment phase.

Liching noted that major Tier‑1 customers such as Hwa‑Yu Vision, Hella and Guangzhou Xiaoci are maintaining warm demand for LED car‑light modules. In addition, new vehicle orders—including Tesla’s affordable models and Xiaomi’s SUV—are moving into mass production from the third quarter, driving a gradual increase in shipments.

At the same time, Liching’s new Mexican plant is expected to begin mass production and shipments in the second half of the year, boosting local supply capability in the North American market, while a new plant in Thailand is also set to commence production later this year.

Beyond the steady growth of its automotive core business, Liching’s robot‑joint control modules have begun small‑scale shipments. The company continues to work with customers on new project development and product specification optimization, aiming to create a second growth curve for its mid‑to‑long‑term operations.

Looking ahead to the second half, Liching remains cautiously optimistic. As new vehicle orders enter mass production, it expects stable shipments of automotive LED products and headlamp controllers. The ramp‑up of the Mexican and Thai plants will further完善 the supply‑chain footprint in North America and Southeast Asia, while the momentum of robot‑joint control module shipments continues to build, strengthening the company’s mid‑to‑long‑term resilience and growth potential.

items.title: 甲骨文被爆180億美元資料中心債務承壓 銀行難出售
items.title_en: Oracle Faces $18 Billion Data Center Debt Pressure, Banks Struggle to Sell
paras: 《金融時報》周五(18日)報導，與甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)在新墨西哥州租用的資料中心相關、規模約180億美元的貸款正面臨壓力，包括Santander和Jefferies在內的聯貸銀行，目前對這些貸款的報價約為每1美元面值對應89至91美分。
位於Doña Ana郡、占地1,400英畝的「Project Jupiter」園區，是甲骨文與OpenAI更廣泛合作協議的一部分，旨在提供AI運算能力。
據悉，該項目去年底從銀行聯貸團取得180億美元貸款，以啟動建設工程。
報導指出，由於市場擔憂甲骨文借款持續增加、信用狀況轉弱，銀行試圖將這筆債務出售給更廣泛投資人群體的努力已陷入停滯。
這座新墨西哥州資料中心園區是「星際之門」(Stargate)計畫的一部分。Stargate是一項規模達5,000億美元的AI基礎設施建設計畫，由OpenAI、軟銀集團(SoftBank)與甲骨文共同主導，目標是在美國各地大規模建設AI基礎設施。
甲骨文的企業信用評級在標普(S&P)7月下調後，目前僅比垃圾級高出一個級距。《金融時報》指出，銀行目前被迫將更多與甲骨文相關的專案債務留在資產負債表上，規模高於最初規劃。
甲骨文持續提高支出，以推動AI基礎設施業務擴張，但不斷攀升的債務負擔也引發投資人越來越多的關注。
甲骨文預估，2027會計年度資本支出最高將達950億美元，但公司預計可從客戶端收回最高250億美元。
paras_en: The Financial Times reported on Friday (the 18th) that a loan of roughly $18 billion tied to Oracle’s (ORCL-US) data center lease in New Mexico is under pressure, with the syndicated lenders—including Santander and Jefferies—currently quoting about 89 to 91 cents on the dollar.
The 1,400‑acre “Project Jupiter” site in Doña Ana County is part of a broader cooperation agreement between Oracle and OpenAI aimed at providing AI compute capacity.
The project reportedly secured the $18 billion loan from a bank syndicate at the end of last year to kick‑off construction.
The report said that because the market worries about Oracle’s growing borrowings and weakening credit, banks’ attempts to sell the debt to a wider pool of investors have stalled.

The New Mexico data‑center campus is part of the “Stargate” initiative, a $500 billion AI infrastructure build‑out led jointly by OpenAI, SoftBank and Oracle to roll out massive AI infrastructure across the United States.

After S&P downgraded Oracle’s corporate credit rating in July, the rating now sits just one notch above junk. The Financial Times noted that banks are forced to keep more Oracle‑related project debt on their balance sheets than originally planned.
Oracle continues to ramp up spending to expand its AI infrastructure business, but the rising debt load is drawing increasing scrutiny from investors.
Oracle projects that capital expenditures could peak at $95 billion in fiscal 2027, while it expects to recover up to $25 billion from its customers.

items.title: 派拉蒙收購華納談判有進展！CNN獨立監督、電影發行承諾成和解條件
items.title_en: Paramount’s Warner Deal Shows Progress: Independent CNN Oversight and Film Release Commitments as Settlement Terms
paras: Paramount Skydance Corporation(派拉蒙) (PSKY-US)與試圖阻止其以1,100億美元收購 Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD-US) 的美國各州政府正在進行和解談判, 知情人士透露, 雙方最快可能在本週末或下週一達成協議. 目前討論中的條件包括對 CNN 實施獨立內容監督, 以及承諾維持一定數量的院線電影發行, 藉此回應州政府對交易可能造成媒體市場集中及新聞內容運作的疑慮.
這項交易總值約1,100億美元, 也是派拉蒙擴大媒體版圖的重要併購案. 目前由加州等12州組成的聯盟向法院提起訴訟, 要求阻止交易完成. 若派拉蒙與州政府達成和解, 將有機會避開原定訴訟程序及可能持續數月的法律爭議, 同時降低因交易延遲而必須支付給 Warner Bros. Discovery 股東的相關費用.

知情人士表示, CNN 內容獨立監督是目前談判中的重要條件之一. CNN 是 Warner Bros. Discovery 旗下主要新聞資產, 因此州政府關注交易完成後, 派拉蒙是否會對 CNN 的新聞內容及編採運作產生影響. 不過, 目前雙方討論的監督機制具體形式仍未確定, 最終條件也可能在談判過程中調整. 加州司法部發言人表示, 相關和解談判屬機密, 因此無法確認或否認談判是否正在進行, 也無法確認相關內容. 派拉蒙則拒絕置評.
另一項正在討論的條件是院線電影發行承諾. 知情人士表示, 雙方正在磋商派拉蒙未來應維持的院線電影發行數量. 這項安排涉及交易完成後的電影內容供給及市場競爭, 也是州政府要求取得保障措施的談判內容之一. Reuters 報導並未透露目前討論中的具體電影數量或期限.
若交易完成, 派拉蒙將取得 Warner Bros. Discovery 旗下包括 CNN 在內的媒體及娛樂資產, 並形成規模更大的媒體公司. Reuters 指出, 這將使合併後企業成為 Netflix (NFLX-US) 與 Disney (DIS-US) 等大型媒體公司的重要競爭者. 因此, 這起交易除了涉及傳統反壟斷問題, CNN 的新聞內容獨立性及電影市場競爭也成為外界關注焦點.
目前這起併購案的最大法律障礙來自12州提起的訴訟. 美國司法部本週已向法院表示, 支持要求提出訴訟的州政府提供保證金. 派拉蒙先前要求相關州政府提供18.8億美元保證金, 理由是若法院發布初步禁制令導致交易延遲, 而最終禁制令遭推翻, 公司可能因此承受巨額損失.
派拉蒙同時面臨交易延遲產生的每日費用. 公司表示, 如果收購案未能在9月30日前完成, 每天將產生約700萬美元的「ticking fee」. 派拉蒙估計, 若案件依照目前程序進行, 審判將於明年3月展開, 到4月作出裁決及完成相關法律程序時, 累計支付給 Warner Bros. Discovery 股東的不可追回費用可能達到13億美元.
就在和解談判傳出進展前一天, 美國聯邦通信委員會(FCC)已批准派拉蒙針對外國投資架構提出的申請, 同意放寬外資持有合併後公司的股權限制. FCC 表示, 個別外國投資人最多可持有20%股權, 並豁免原本25%的外資持股上限, 但外國投資人不得持有具投票權的股份, 也不得影響派拉蒙的內容決策及公司管理.
FCC 文件指出, 中東投資者在交易完成後合計可能持有派拉蒙約85%的股權, 其中沙烏地阿拉伯公共投資基金可能持有15.1%. 不過, 派拉蒙表示, 合併完成後由甲骨文(ORCL-US)共同創辦人 Larry Ellison 家族及 RedBird Capital Partners 掌握100%投票權, 其他股東不具公司治理權. 派拉蒙表示, 相關安排是在美國國家安全審查後確定.
反壟斷訴訟方面, 12州聯盟認為這起交易可能使合併後公司在電影及電視市場取得過大的市場力量, 並可能對產業競爭及價格產生影響. 除州政府外, 美國作家協會也對交易提出法律挑戰. 美國司法部則已批准這項交易, 因此目前阻止交易完成的主要障礙集中在州政府提起的訴訟.
市場方面, 和解談判消息傳出後, 派拉蒙股價在盤後交易一度上漲近7%, Warner Bros. Discovery 股價則上漲8.4%, 顯示投資人對交易可能取得進展的消息作出正面反應. 不過, 知情人士強調談判仍在進行, 條件可能改變, 是否能在本週末或下週一正式達成協議仍有待觀察.
如果最終達成和解, CNN 內容獨立監督及院線電影發行承諾可能成為派拉蒙化解州政府反對的核心條件. 不過, 即使雙方達成協議, 後續仍須處理法院程序及其他交易完成條件. 因此, 這場1,100億美元媒體併購案能否順利完成, 最終仍取決於和解協議內容及法院對相關法律程序的處理.
paras_en: Paramount Skydance Corp (PSKY-US) and U.S. state governments trying to block its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD-US) are in settlement talks, sources say, with an agreement possibly reached as early as this weekend or next Monday. The terms under discussion include independent content oversight of CNN and a commitment to maintain a certain volume of theatrical film releases, aimed at addressing state concerns about media market concentration and news operations.

The transaction, valued at roughly $110 billion, is a key acquisition for Paramount to expand its media footprint. A coalition of 12 states, led by California, has sued in federal court to stop the deal. If Paramount reaches a settlement with the states, it could avoid the planned litigation and months‑long legal battles, while also reducing the fees it would have to pay Warner Bros. Discovery shareholders if the deal is delayed.

Sources say independent oversight of CNN content is a major condition in the talks. CNN is Warner’s flagship news asset, so states are worried that a Paramount takeover could affect its editorial independence. The exact form of the oversight mechanism is still unsettled and could change during negotiations. A California Department of Justice spokesperson said the settlement talks are confidential, so they cannot confirm or deny any details, and Paramount declined to comment.

Another condition under discussion is a commitment to theatrical film releases. Insiders say the parties are negotiating the number of movies Paramount must continue to release in theaters after the deal closes. This arrangement concerns post‑closing content supply and market competition and is one of the safeguards the states are seeking. Reuters did not disclose the specific number of films or the time frame being discussed.

If the deal closes, Paramount will acquire Warner’s media and entertainment assets, including CNN, creating a larger media company. Reuters notes the combined entity would become a serious competitor to large players such as Netflix (NFLX-US) and Disney (DIS-US). Thus, beyond traditional antitrust concerns, the independence of CNN’s news content and competition in the film market have become focal points for observers.

The biggest legal hurdle remains the lawsuit filed by the 12‑state coalition. The U.S. Justice Department this week told the court it supports the states’ request for a bond. Paramount previously asked the states to post an $1.88 billion bond, arguing that if a preliminary injunction delayed the deal and was later overturned, the company could suffer massive losses.

Paramount also faces daily costs from a delayed closing. The company says that if the acquisition is not completed by September 30, it will incur about $7 million per day in a “ticking fee.” Paramount estimates that, following the current schedule, a trial would begin in March next year and a ruling by April could result in unrecoverable fees to Warner shareholders of up to $1.3 billion.

Just a day before news of settlement progress emerged, the Federal Communications Commission approved Paramount’s request to relax foreign‑ownership limits for the merged company. The FCC said individual foreign investors may hold up to 20% of equity, waiving the usual 25% cap, but they may not hold voting shares or influence Paramount’s content decisions or management.

FCC documents indicate that Middle‑East investors could collectively own about 85% of Paramount after the deal, with Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund potentially holding 15.1%. Paramount says that, post‑merger, 100% of voting rights will be held by Oracle co‑founder Larry Ellison’s family and RedBird Capital Partners, with other shareholders having no governance rights. The arrangement will be confirmed after a U.S. national‑security review.

On antitrust grounds, the 12‑state coalition argues the merger would give the combined company excessive market power in film and TV, potentially harming competition and pricing. In addition to the states, the Authors Guild has also filed a legal challenge. The Justice Department has already approved the transaction, so the primary obstacle now is the states’ lawsuit.

After the settlement news broke, Paramount’s shares rose nearly 7% in after‑hours trading, while Warner Bros. Discovery’s stock jumped 8.4%, showing investors responded positively to the prospect of progress. However, insiders stress the talks are ongoing, terms could change, and it remains uncertain whether an agreement will be reached by the weekend or next Monday.

If a settlement is finally reached, independent CNN oversight and the theatrical film‑release commitment could become the core conditions for Paramount to overcome state opposition. Even with an agreement, court procedures and other closing conditions would still need to be addressed, so the fate of this $110 billion media merger ultimately depends on the settlement details and how courts handle the remaining legal steps.

items.title: 路透：川習會前美中磋商降低LNG關稅 研議300億美元互惠降稅方案
items.title_en: Reuters: US-China Talks Ahead of Trump‑Xi Meeting to Cut LNG Tariffs, Discuss $30 B Reciprocal Tariff Reductions
paras: 美國與中國正磋商降低或取消中國對美國液化天然氣 (LNG) 課徵的15%關稅，並研議由雙方各自削減約300億美元商品關稅。相關措施可能納入更廣泛的能源與農產品協議，在中國國家主席習近平下週訪問華府期間公布。
《路透》引述兩名知情人士報導，美國總統川普與習近平預定9月24日在華府會晤，雙方正透過關稅談判穩定經貿關係，但目前尚未達成最終協議。白宮與中國駐美大使館均未回應置評要求。
15%關稅近乎切斷美中LNG貿易
中國於2025年2月對美國LNG加徵15%關稅，以反制川普政府對中國商品課徵的關稅。這項措施近乎切斷美中LNG貿易，美國輸中LNG船次由2024年的64艘降至2025年幾乎為零。
美國輸中LNG船次曾於2021年達到131艘的歷史高點。川普第一任期內爆發美中貿易爭端後，2019年一度降至僅2艘，隨後於2020及2021年大幅回升。
儘管15%關稅仍未取消，LSEG航運數據顯示，近幾個月已有數批由美國墨西哥灣沿岸出口設施出發的LNG抵達中國或正在駛往中國，顯示中國買家已逐步重返美國市場。
中國是全球最大LNG進口國，美國則是全球最大LNG出口國，雙方都有恢復能源貿易的經濟誘因。若中國降低或取消關稅，美國生產商將重新取得重要出口市場，中國買家也能擴大天然氣供應來源。
美國擴大LNG產能 仍有2,450萬噸未簽長約
美國LNG產業正進入大規模擴產期，隨著新建及擴建設施陸續投產，出口產能截至2027年預計增加約每日100億立方英尺。
包括Cheniere Energy (LNG-US)、Venture Global (VG-US)、Sempra (SRE-US)、NextDecade (NEXT-US) 及埃克森美孚 (XOM-US) 在內的業者均在增加產能。美國今年上半年LNG出口量平均為每日174億立方英尺，較去年同期成長23%。
根據業界估計及路透分析，美國目前在建LNG產能接近1億噸，其中2,450萬噸尚未與長期客戶簽約。中國買家若恢復採購，可望為正在施工或尋求融資及長期客戶的美國LNG計畫提供更多需求。
全球能源流向改變也提高亞洲市場的重要性。俄羅斯2022年入侵烏克蘭後，歐洲取得俄羅斯管線天然氣受到干擾，原本可能運往亞洲的美國LNG轉而流向歐洲。美國與伊朗持續交戰並擾亂能源供應，也加劇亞洲市場對LNG貨源的競爭。
不過，降低關稅未必會立即為美國LNG業者帶來大量新增收入。中國停止進口美國LNG後，部分中國買家仍履行與美國供應商簽訂的長期合約，但在購入後將貨物轉售至其他市場。
農產品可望成為另一協議重點
除了能源，美中也可能在農產品貿易方面取得進展。美國2024年對中國農產品出口額達290億美元，其中以黃豆為主。農產品在雙邊經貿關係中的敏感度相對較低，因此被視為較可能達成協議的領域。
根據白宮說法，中國去年在南韓釜山峰會上同意，截至2028年每年採購2,500萬噸美國黃豆。美國官員並表示，北京在川普今年5月訪中期間，同意額外採購價值170億美元的其他美國農產品。
北京從未證實上述承諾，但目前仍有望完成黃豆採購目標。若要落實另外170億美元的農產品採購，可能需要豁免貿易戰後仍保留的10%關稅。
美國貿易代表葛里爾9月3日表示，政府可能宣布鼓勵美國農產品對中銷售的措施。分析人士預期，美方可能給予部分關稅豁免，高粱與玉米可能成為受惠品項。
能源關稅也可能納入雙方各削減約300億美元商品關稅的方案。中國去年對美國石油及天然氣課徵10%至15%關稅後，相關進口陷入停滯。2020年至2024年間，中國每年進口的美國能源規模介於75億至120億美元。
制裁與稀土仍是峰會爭點
相較於能源與農產品可能出現進展，制裁與稀土問題仍有待美中協商。
中國長期是伊朗與俄羅斯原油的主要買家之一，美國多年來已針對參與相關交易的煉油商及其他實體實施制裁。川普曾表示將考慮解除部分制裁，但相關措施目前仍然有效。
美國財長貝森特自8月以來也推動對協助伊朗貿易融資的銀行實施次級制裁，但中國銀行目前並未被納入相關措施。
稀土方面，中國限制對美出口曾促使川普重返談判桌。儘管目前已有更多稀土材料由中國流向美國，問題仍未完全解決。美國航太及晶片等敏感產業仍面臨取得材料的困難，部分中國出口商也因擔心雙邊關係再度惡化而不願向美國供貨。
隨著川習會進入倒數，美中能否先在LNG關稅、農產品採購及互惠降稅方案上取得進展，將成為峰會的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: The United States and China are negotiating to lower or eliminate the 15% tariff China imposed on U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) and are considering a reciprocal reduction of about $30 billion each in product tariffs. The measures could be part of a broader energy and agricultural agreement announced during Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington next week.

Reuters, citing two informed sources, reported that U.S. President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping are scheduled to meet in Washington on September 24, with both sides using tariff talks to stabilise trade relations, though no final deal has been reached yet. Neither the White House nor the Chinese embassy in Washington responded to requests for comment.
The 15% tariff nearly cuts off U.S.–China LNG trade

China imposed a 15% tariff on U.S. LNG in February 2025 as retaliation for tariffs the Trump administration placed on Chinese goods. The move has almost halted U.S.–China LNG trade, with shipments from the United States to China dropping from 64 vessels in 2024 to virtually none in 2025.

U.S. LNG shipments to China peaked at a historic 131 vessels in 2021. After the trade dispute erupted in Trump’s first term, shipments fell to just two vessels in 2019, then rebounded sharply in 2020 and 2021.

Although the 15% tariff remains in place, LSEG shipping data show that in recent months several LNG cargoes from U.S. Gulf Coast export terminals have arrived in China or are en route, indicating that Chinese buyers are gradually returning to the U.S. market.

China is the world’s largest LNG importer and the United States the largest exporter, giving both sides economic incentives to resume energy trade. If China lowers or removes the tariff, U.S. producers would regain a key export market and Chinese buyers would broaden their gas supply sources.
U.S. Expands LNG Capacity – Still $24.5 million Tons Uncommitted
U.S. LNG developers are entering a large‑scale expansion phase, with new and expanded facilities coming online and export capacity expected to rise by roughly 10 billion cubic feet per day by 2027.

Companies such as Cheniere Energy (LNG‑US), Venture Global (VG‑US), Sempra (SRE‑US), NextDecade (NEXT‑US) and ExxonMobil (XOM‑US) are all adding capacity. In the first half of this year, U.S. LNG exports averaged 174 billion cubic feet per day, up 23% year‑over‑year.

Industry estimates and Reuters analysis indicate that the U.S. has nearly 100 million tons of LNG under construction, of which 24.5 million tons have not yet been signed to long‑term customers. If Chinese buyers resume purchases, they could provide additional demand for projects still under construction or seeking financing and long‑term contracts.

Shifts in global energy flows are raising the importance of Asian markets. After Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine disrupted Europe’s pipeline gas supplies, U.S. LNG that might have gone to Asia has been redirected to Europe. Ongoing U.S.–Iran conflict and related supply disruptions also heighten competition for LNG in Asia.

However, cutting the tariff may not instantly generate large new revenues for U.S. LNG firms. After China halted U.S. LNG imports, some Chinese buyers continued to honor long‑term contracts with U.S. suppliers, then resold the cargoes to other markets after purchase.
Agricultural Products Could Become Another Focus of the Deal

Beyond energy, the two sides may also make headway on agricultural trade. In 2024 U.S. agricultural exports to China totalled $29 billion, dominated by soybeans. Because ag‑goods are less politically sensitive, they are seen as a more attainable area for agreement.

According to the White House, China agreed at the Busan summit last year to purchase 25 million tons of U.S. soybeans each year through 2028. U.S. officials also said Beijing pledged an additional $17 billion worth of other U.S. farm products during Trump’s May visit to China this year.

Beijing has never confirmed those commitments, but the soybean target remains within reach. To fulfil the extra $17 billion of farm‑product purchases, a waiver of the remaining 10% post‑trade‑war tariff may be required.

U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai said on September 3 that the administration may announce measures to encourage U.S. farm sales to China. Analysts expect partial tariff exemptions, with sorghum and corn likely to benefit.

Energy tariffs could also be folded into the roughly $30 billion reciprocal tariff‑cut plan. After China imposed 10%‑15% duties on U.S. oil and gas last year, related imports stalled. Between 2020 and 2024, China’s annual imports of U.S. energy ranged from $7.5 billion to $12 billion.
Sanctions and Rare‑Earths Remain Summit Hot‑Button Issues
Compared with potential progress on energy and agriculture, sanctions and rare‑earth matters still require negotiation.

China has long been a major buyer of Iranian and Russian crude, and the U.S. has sanctioned refineries and other entities involved in those trades. Trump has said he may consider easing some sanctions, but the measures remain in effect.
Since August, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has pushed secondary sanctions on banks that finance Iranian trade, though Chinese banks have not yet been targeted.

On rare‑earths, Chinese limits on U.S. exports helped bring Trump back to the negotiating table. While more rare‑earth material now flows from China to the United States, the issue is not fully resolved. Sensitive U.S. aerospace and chip sectors still face supply challenges, and some Chinese exporters hesitate to ship to the U.S. for fear of further bilateral strain.

As the Trump‑Xi summit enters its final countdown, whether the two sides can first make headway on LNG tariffs, farm‑product purchases and a reciprocal tariff‑reduction framework will be a key focus of the summit.

items.title: 長鑫存儲傳進軍NAND市場 美光、SK海力士該緊張了？
items.title_en: CXMT Said to Enter NAND Market, Should Micron and SK Hynix Be Worried?
paras: 中國DRAM製造商長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 傳出準備跨足NAND快閃記憶體，可能使全球NAND市場競爭進一步升溫。不過，由於長鑫存儲若投入商業生產，初期可能以中國市場為主，受到直接衝擊的可能是中國同業長江存儲 (YMTC)，而非美光或SK海力士。
《巴隆週刊》引述路透週五報導指出，長鑫存儲計劃在北京一座新廠建立NAND快閃記憶體研發生產線，將產品版圖由DRAM擴展至NAND。長鑫存儲尚未回應置評要求，目前也未確認是否會推進NAND商業化生產，以及可能的量產時間。
DRAM主要用於電腦及人工智慧 (AI) 硬體，負責暫時儲存運作中的資料與程序；NAND則用於較長期的資料儲存。長鑫存儲原本專注於DRAM，一旦正式進軍NAND市場，將加入三星電子、SK海力士、美光、SanDisk及長江存儲等業者的競爭行列。
根據Counterpoint Research資料，三星電子第二季以28%的市占率居全球NAND市場首位，SK海力士以19%排名第二；美光市占率約15%，長江存儲為14%，SanDisk則占11%。
長鑫存儲若大舉投入NAND，可能使市場版圖進一步分散。美光與SK海力士目前均有約四分之一營收來自NAND，但美光的NAND市占率低於SK海力士，因此可能流失給中國業者的既有市場相對較小。
相較之下，長江存儲可能面臨更直接的競爭壓力。若長鑫存儲初期將業務重心放在中國市場，其對長江存儲構成的威脅，可能高於對美光或SK海力士的影響。
短期而言，記憶體市場快速擴張，仍可為既有業者提供營收與獲利成長空間。Counterpoint數據顯示，第二季DRAM市場較前一季成長57%，NAND市場季增70%。
長鑫存儲能否將研發計畫推進至商業量產，仍有待觀察。
美光 (MU-US) 週五勁揚 3.92%，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 2.46%。
paras_en: Chinese DRAM maker CXMT (ChangXin Memory Technologies) is rumored to be preparing to enter the NAND flash memory market, which could further heat up global NAND competition. However, if CXMT moves to commercial production, its initial focus is likely to be the Chinese market, meaning the direct impact would be on domestic rival YMTC rather than on Micron or SK Hynix.

Baron Weekly cited a Reuters report on Friday that CXMT plans to set up a NAND flash R&D and production line at a new plant in Beijing, expanding its product portfolio from DRAM to NAND. CXMT has not responded to comment requests, and it has not confirmed whether it will pursue commercial NAND production or the timeline for possible mass production.

DRAM is primarily used in computers and AI hardware to temporarily store data and programs in operation, while NAND is used for longer‑term data storage. CXMT has so far focused on DRAM, and a formal entry into the NAND market would put it in competition with Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Micron, SanDisk and YMTC.
According to Counterpoint Research, Samsung led the global NAND market in Q2 with a 28% share, SK Hynix was second with 19%, Micron held about 15%, YMTC 14% and SanDisk 11%.

If CXMT makes a big push into NAND, the market could become even more fragmented. Micron and SK Hynix each derive roughly a quarter of their revenue from NAND, but Micron’s NAND share is lower than SK Hynix’s, so the amount of existing market that could be lost to a Chinese player is relatively smaller.

By contrast, YMTC could face more direct competitive pressure. If CXMT initially concentrates its business on the Chinese market, the threat to YMTC could be greater than its impact on Micron or SK Hynix.

In the short term, the memory market is expanding rapidly, still offering existing players revenue and profit growth opportunities. Counterpoint data show Q2 DRAM grew 57% versus the previous quarter, while the NAND market rose 70% quarter‑over‑quarter.
Whether CXMT can advance its R&D plans to commercial mass production remains to be seen.
Micron (MU-US) surged 3.92% on Friday, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) rose 2.46%.

items.title: 央行不跟進聯準會升息、台積電除息秀、華邦電收購英飛凌記憶體事業 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Central Bank Doesn't Follow Fed Rate Hike, TSMC Dividend, Winbond Acquires Infineon's Memory Business – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美國聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息1碼，台灣央行則不跟進，利率連10凍；台積電周三除息，當日即完成填息；華邦電周三宣布，以356億元收購英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈央行理監事會〉利率連10凍、對房市鬆綁 楊金龍不跟進美國升息：走自己的路 

儘管美國聯準會甫宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，台灣是否跟進引發國內各界討論，但台灣央行周四 (17日) 召開第三季理監事會議，仍宣布利率「連 10 凍」，央行總裁楊金龍說，「我們走我們的路」；同時，此次央行放鬆對房市的選擇性信用管制措施，調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成。

台積電除息7元 填息後攻上2400元

台積電(2330-TW)周三(16日)進行除息，每股配發現金股利7元，除息參考價為2378元，當天盤中完成填息後，一路走高，周五以2460元作收，順利展開填息行情。台積電自2019年改採季配息以來，歷次除息均順利完成填息，當中更有22次於除息當日填息完畢，加上今日紀錄，共有23次於除息當日填息完畢。

華邦電砸356億元收購英飛凌記憶體事業 Spansion品牌復活 

華邦電(2344-TW)周三(16日)召開重訊記者會宣布海外併購案，與英飛凌旗下Infineon Technologies LLC簽署股份購買協議，以全現金方式取得英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，基礎交易價格達11.2億美元，折合新台幣約356.23億元，預計2027年下半年完成交易，收購完畢後，標的公司將以「Spansion」為名，延續該品牌價值。

大立光再砸11.72億元購入台中精密機械園區土地廠房 

光學元件廠大立光 (3008-TW)繼在台中工業區購地接連出手後，並在精密機械園區持續購地，大立光周四(17日)公布以11.72億元在精密機械園區內取得產業用不動產，賣方爲台灣固而美工業。

SOGO大巨蛋商場今開幕 遠東徐國安到場喊拚零售創新 

遠東SOGO大巨蛋商場Garden City周三(16日)正式開幕，董事長黃晴雯表示，試營運至今近一個月，業績較預期高出2成，全年業績有望達百億元目標，儘管緊鄰東區商圈和既有的忠孝SOGO和復興SOGO，客源並未受排擠，反而大巨蛋商場有效為SOGO導入更多年輕客源。

電價續凍漲！審議會拍板優先爭取政府711億補助 費率延至12月併審 

經濟部周五(18日)召開115年第2次電價費率審議會，會後記者會由次長賴建信主持。審議委員會指出，影響本期電價的主因為中東戰事，國際燃料價格大漲導致發購電成本大幅攀升，為避免引發國內物價波動，會議決議支持優先爭取政府撥補預算711億元，因此本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議輸配電費率時再行討論，意味著最快調漲電價的時間點將落在明年1月。

物價破2%免驚！葉俊顯估今年GDP挑戰「摸到12%」溫和通膨如健康體溫將成常態 

對近期國際經濟情勢與台灣整體經濟展望，國發會主委葉俊顯周二(15日)受訪時展現高度樂觀態度。針對市場擔憂國際油價波動及 AI 技術發展可能放緩等變數，葉俊顯明確指出，台灣經濟基本面極具韌性，在今年全年 GDP 成長率在出口強勁堆疊下，有機會進一步衝刺「摸到 12%」的新高點。他並強調未來溫和通膨將如「健康體溫」，不見得一定在2%以下，有時壓得太低反對經濟不健康。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced a 0.25 percentage point rate hike on Wednesday (the 16th), but Taiwan's central bank did not follow suit, keeping rates frozen for the tenth consecutive meeting; TSMC declared a dividend on Wednesday and completed the price recovery the same day; Winbond announced on Wednesday that it will acquire 100% of Infineon's NOR Flash and related memory business for NT$35.6 billion. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

At the central bank’s board meeting on Thursday (the 17th), the bank announced that interest rates remain frozen for the tenth straight meeting, with Governor Yang Jin‑long saying “we are walking our own path.” At the same time, the bank relaxed selective credit controls on the housing market, raising the maximum loan‑to‑value ratio for a buyer’s second home from 60% to 70%.

TSMC (2330‑TW) went ex‑dividend on Wednesday (the 16th), distributing a cash dividend of NT$7 per share. The ex‑dividend reference price was NT$2,378. After the dividend was filled in during the same trading session, the stock rose and closed at NT$2,460 on Friday, successfully completing the dividend‑fill rally. Since switching to quarterly dividends in 2019, TSMC has always filled the dividend on the ex‑date, achieving this on the day of the ex‑dividend 23 times, including today.

Winbond (2344‑TW) held a major press conference on Wednesday (the 16th) to announce an overseas acquisition. It signed a share purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon, to acquire 100% of the NOR Flash and related memory business for cash. The base transaction price is US$1.12 billion, roughly NT$35.623 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2027. After the acquisition, the target will operate under the “Spansion” brand to preserve its brand value.

Largan Precision (3008‑TW) continued its land‑buying spree after earlier purchases in the Taichung industrial zone. On Thursday (the 17th) it announced a NT$1.172 billion purchase of industrial‑use real estate in the Precision Machinery Park, buying the property from Taiwan’s Guremei Industrial.

Far Eastern SOGO’s Grand Arena Mall, Garden City, officially opened on Wednesday (the 16th). Chairman Huang Qing‑wen said that after nearly a month of trial operation, performance is about 20% higher than expected, and the mall is on track to reach a NT$100 billion annual target. Despite being adjacent to the East District commercial area and existing SOGO locations in Zhongxiao and Fuxing, the new mall has not cannibalized traffic; instead, it has attracted more young shoppers to SOGO.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs held the second 2023 electricity‑price review meeting on Friday (the 18th). The committee noted that the main driver of the current price review is the Middle‑East conflict, which has pushed international fuel prices sharply higher and raised power‑generation costs. To avoid domestic price volatility, the meeting voted to prioritize securing a NT$71.1 billion government subsidy, leaving the current price adjustment undecided until it is reconsidered with transmission‑and‑distribution rates at the third review meeting in December, meaning the earliest possible rate hike would be in January 2024.

National Development Council Chairman Yeh Jun‑hsian expressed strong optimism on Tuesday (the 15th) about Taiwan’s economic outlook despite recent global uncertainties. He said that Taiwan’s economy is resilient and, with strong export momentum, could push full‑year GDP growth toward a “touch‑12%” target. He also emphasized that moderate inflation, akin to a healthy body temperature, does not have to stay below 2%; keeping it too low could hinder a healthy economy.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉癌症疫苗重大突破 基因免疫主題ETF 00898、00897強勢攻高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Major Breakthrough in Cancer Vaccine Boosts Gene Immunity ETFs 00898 and 00897
paras: 受惠於國際生技巨頭在個人化 mRNA 癌症疫苗臨床試驗取得歷史性突破，於台股掛牌的相關海外生技 ETF 展現強勁爆發力。其中，國泰基因免疫革命(00898-TW)本周市價大漲 8.65%，18 日收在 11.43 元，創掛牌以來新高；富邦基因免疫生技(00897-TW) 亦不甘示弱，周漲幅達 6.36%，收在 13.37 元。兩檔聚焦前沿基因與免疫療法的 ETF 雙雙成為市場焦點。
市場法人分析，本次生技族群強勢發動的主因，源於生技大廠莫德納(Moderna)與默克(Merck)共同宣布其個人化 mRNA 癌症疫苗(INTerpath-001)第三期臨床試驗成果輝煌。試驗數據顯示，該療法能顯著延長黑色素瘤患者術後的「無復發存活期」與「無遠端轉移存活期」。
這項結果證實了 mRNA 技術成功從傳統傳染病防護擴展至精準腫瘤治療，開闢了龐大的新藥商業化空間，激勵莫德納股價強勢噴發，並直接帶動全球基因醫療供應鏈與概念股全面狂歡。
由於國泰 00898 與富邦 00897 均選入高度聚焦基因編輯、免疫細胞療法與精準診斷的指標企業，產業純度極高，因而成為這波生技股重估行情的最大受惠者。
富邦 00897 第一大持股即為莫德納，權重高達 8.73%，搭配其布局默克權重 3.61% 及 Regeneron、Vertex 等大型藥廠，此外，Revolution Medicines (RVMD-US) 等標靶 RAS 突變癌症新藥研發公司亦獲得資金追捧。00897 本周累計漲幅6.36%。
國泰 00898 持股重心則更加彈性且多元，前三大持股包括 Iovance Biotherapeutics(5.12%)、GeneDx(5.04%)與 Twist Bioscience(4.52%)，同時涵蓋莫德納與癌症基因檢測大廠 Natera、Guardant Health 等，在中小型標的衝刺下，本周彈升力道更為猛烈，漲幅達8.65%。
法人指出，由於基因編輯、精準檢測與癌症疫苗具備不可替代的技術壁壘，且 9 月中旬歐洲腫瘤醫學會(ESMO)公布多項突破性臨床數據，吸引避險與成長型資金逆勢回流。在 AI 製藥與新藥商業化加速的背景下，基因免疫主題仍將是中長期資金配置的焦點。

paras_en: Benefiting from a historic breakthrough in personalized mRNA cancer vaccine trials by international biotech giants, related overseas biotech ETFs listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange showed strong explosive performance. Cathay Gene Immunity Revolution (00898‑TW) surged 8.65% this week, closing at NT$11.43 on the 18th, a new high since its listing; Fubon Gene Immunity Biotech (00897‑TW) was not far behind, up 6.36% for the week and closing at NT$13.37. Both ETFs, which focus on cutting‑edge gene and immunotherapy, became market focal points.

Market analysts attribute the biotech sector’s rally to the joint announcement by Moderna and Merck that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine (INTerpath‑001) achieved spectacular results in Phase III trials. The data showed the therapy significantly extended both disease‑free survival and distant‑metastasis‑free survival for post‑surgery melanoma patients.

The outcome confirms that mRNA technology can successfully expand from traditional infectious‑disease protection to precision oncology, opening a huge commercial drug space, spurring Moderna’s stock to rally and driving a broad celebration across the global gene‑therapy supply chain and related concept stocks.

Because both Cathay 00898 and Fubon 00897 select highly focused companies in gene editing, cell‑based immunotherapy and precision diagnostics, their portfolio purity is extremely high, making them the biggest beneficiaries of this biotech re‑valuation wave.

Fubon 00897’s top holding is Moderna, accounting for 8.73% of the fund, complemented by a 3.61% stake in Merck and positions in large pharma such as Regeneron and Vertex. It also attracted capital to target‑focused RAS‑mutation cancer drug developers like Revolution Medicines (RVMD‑US). The fund posted a cumulative weekly gain of 6.36%.

Cathay 00898’s holdings are more flexible and diversified, with the three largest positions being Iovance Biotherapeutics (5.12%), GeneDx (5.04%) and Twist Bioscience (4.52%). It also includes Moderna and major cancer‑genomics players Natera and Guardant Health, and the surge in small‑ and mid‑cap targets drove a sharper weekly rise of 8.65%.

Analysts note that gene editing, precision testing and cancer vaccines have irreplaceable technical barriers, and that the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) released multiple breakthrough clinical data in mid‑September, attracting defensive and growth capital back into the sector. Amid accelerating AI‑driven drug discovery and drug commercialization, the gene‑immunity theme will remain a focal point for medium‑ to long‑term fund allocation.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗清車用、AI領域雙布局 周漲逾1成回升至2個月來高價
items.title_en: Hot Stocks: Liching Targets Automotive and AI Sectors, Weekly Rise Over 10% Returns to Two-Month High
paras: 車用零組件廠麗清(3346-TW)本周股價反彈12%，回升至2個月來糕點，反映8月合併營收衝上近16個月高點，麗清表示，墨西哥新廠預計自下半年開始量產出貨，而布局AI領域也推進，機器人關節的控制模組產品已陸續進入小量出貨階段。
麗清指出，華域視覺、海拉、廣州小糸等主要Tier 1客戶對LED車燈模組備貨需求持續增溫，加上特斯拉平價車款、小米SUV等新車款訂單於第三季起陸續進入量產階段，帶動出貨逐步增加。
同時，麗清墨西哥新廠預計自下半年開始量產出貨，提升在北美市場的在地供應能力，而泰國新廠也於下半年推進投入生產行列。
除車用本業營運逐步成長外，麗清旗下應用於機器人關節控制控制模組產品，已陸續進入小量出貨階段，目前仍持續與客戶推進新專案研發與產品規格優化，拚為中長期營運打造第二成長曲線。
展望下半年，麗清維持審慎樂觀，隨著新車款訂單陸續進入量產出貨，預期車用LED產品及頭燈控制器出貨表現可望維持穩健，而隨著墨西哥、泰國新廠陸續投入量產，在北美及東南亞供應鏈布局將更趨完善；另一方面，機器人關節控制模組出貨動能持續累積，強化中長期營運韌性與成長動能。
paras_en: Automotive component maker Liching (3346‑TW) saw its stock rebound 12% this week, climbing back to a two‑month high, reflecting August consolidated revenue hitting a near 16‑month peak. Liching said its new plant in Mexico is slated to start mass production and shipments in the second half of the year, and its AI‑related push is advancing, with robot‑joint control module products now entering a small‑scale shipment phase.

Liching noted that major Tier‑1 customers such as Hwa‑Yu Vision, Hella and Guangzhou Xiaoci are maintaining warm demand for LED car‑light modules. In addition, new vehicle orders—including Tesla’s affordable models and Xiaomi’s SUV—are moving into mass production from the third quarter, driving a gradual increase in shipments.

At the same time, Liching’s new Mexican plant is expected to begin mass production and shipments in the second half of the year, boosting local supply capability in the North American market, while a new plant in Thailand is also set to commence production later this year.

Beyond the steady growth of its automotive core business, Liching’s robot‑joint control modules have begun small‑scale shipments. The company continues to work with customers on new project development and product specification optimization, aiming to create a second growth curve for its mid‑to‑long‑term operations.

Looking ahead to the second half, Liching remains cautiously optimistic. As new vehicle orders enter mass production, it expects stable shipments of automotive LED products and headlamp controllers. The ramp‑up of the Mexican and Thai plants will further完善 the supply‑chain footprint in North America and Southeast Asia, while the momentum of robot‑joint control module shipments continues to build, strengthening the company’s mid‑to‑long‑term resilience and growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉低軌衛星與太空軍商機引爆 耀登谷底翻周漲逾21%登百元大關
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite and Space Force Opportunities Ignite Yao‑Deng’s Bottom‑Out, Weekly Rise Over 21% to Cross the 100‑Dollar Mark
paras: 受惠於SpaceX星艦第14次飛行測試在即與美國太空軍首度證實在軌部署武器等太空國防題材催化，射頻天線與通訊模組大廠耀登(3138-TW)本周股價強勁，18日收108元，周漲21.3%，周成交量5975張。
耀登今年大幅提升研發投入，預估全年研發費用占營收比重將達16%至17%，改寫近3至5年以來新高紀錄。耀登研發重點鎖定低軌衛星終端設備的機構設計與散熱技術，並於竹北增設天線研發據點，且已於今年3月取得國家太空中心Ka頻段標案並於下半年陸續交付，同時持續與美系低軌衛星營運商及中小型客戶洽談合作，相關專案有望在今年第3季與第4季更加明朗。
在產能布局與射頻天線本業方面，耀登越南新廠預定於今年第3季正式投產，初期設置3條產線，未來可進一步擴充至18條，整體產能預期將大幅提升5至6倍，主力鎖定非紅供應鏈的轉單與新訂單需求。
在筆電天線領域，耀登受惠美系客戶供應占比持續提升，躍居主要供應商之一，並成功切入兩家新品牌客戶共同開發新案，加上量測設備代理與認證服務拓展至衛星地面收發設備，為整體營運增添多元柴火。
paras_en: Benefiting from SpaceX’s Starship 14th flight test and the U.S. Space Force’s first confirmation of on‑orbit weapon deployment, which have spurred space‑defense themes, RF antenna and communications module maker Yao‑Deng (3138‑TW) saw a strong price move this week, closing at NT$108 on the 18th, up 21.3% for the week with a volume of 5,975 lots.

Yao‑Deng has dramatically increased its R&D spending this year, forecasting that research and development expenses will account for 16%‑17% of revenue for the full year, a new high for the past three to five years. The R&D focus is on mechanical design and thermal‑management technology for low‑Earth‑orbit satellite terminal equipment, with a new antenna R&D site added in Zhubei. The company secured the National Space Center’s Ka‑band contract in March and will begin deliveries in the second half of the year, while continuing talks with U.S. LEO satellite operators and small‑to‑medium customers; related projects are expected to become clearer in Q3 and Q4 of this year.

Regarding capacity expansion and its core RF‑antenna business, Yao‑Deng’s new plant in Vietnam is slated to start production in Q3 of this year. The initial setup will include three production lines, with the potential to expand to 18 lines later, boosting overall capacity by roughly five‑ to six‑fold and targeting order transfers and new orders outside the traditional “red” supply chain.

In the laptop‑antenna segment, Yao‑Deng benefits from a rising share of supplies to U.S. customers, climbing to become one of the main suppliers. It has also successfully entered two new brand customers for joint development projects, and has expanded its measurement‑equipment agency and certification services to satellite ground‑station equipment, adding diversified revenue streams to its overall operations.

items.title: 工業富聯股份回購實施完畢 斥人民幣10億元買回1583萬股
items.title_en: Foxconn Industrial Internet Completes Share Repurchase, Spends 1 Billion RMB to Buy Back 15.83 Million Shares
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(18)日代子公司工業富聯(Fii)(601138-CN)公告，股份回購實施完畢，已斥10億元人民幣(下同)，買回1583.33萬股，買回均價為每股63.16元。
工業富聯表示，截至公告披露日，本次股份回購計畫已達到回購金額下限，經公司管理層決定，本次回購實施完畢，此次買回股份約占總股本0.08%，回購最高價格為66.40元、最低為59.91元。
工業富聯7月27日公告，基於對未來發展前景的信心及對長期價值的認可，並維護股東權益、增強投資者信心，在不超過3個月內實施股份回購，回購資金規模總額不低於10億元、不超過20億元，每股買回價格不超過103元。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today, on behalf of its subsidiary Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII) (601138‑CN), that its share repurchase program has been completed, spending 1 billion RMB to buy back 15.8333 million shares at an average price of 63.16 RMB per share.

FII stated that as of the disclosure date, the repurchase plan has reached its lower funding limit. The board decided to conclude the buy‑back, which represents about 0.08% of total equity. The highest repurchase price was 66.40 RMB and the lowest was 59.91 RMB per share.

On July 27, FII announced that, confident in its future prospects and long‑term value, and to protect shareholder rights and boost investor confidence, it would conduct a share repurchase within three months, with total funds not less than 1 billion RMB and not exceeding 2 billion RMB, and a maximum purchase price of 103 RMB per share.

items.title: 當冰山理論搬進辦公室 裕融攜手青藝盟用戲劇看見情緒 拉近職場溝通距離
items.title_en: When the Iceberg Theory Moves Into the Office, Yulon Partners with the Youth Arts Alliance to Use Drama to See Emotions and Bridge Workplace Communication Gaps
paras: 裕融(9941-TW)近期與青少年表演藝術聯盟(簡稱青藝盟)合作，至裕隆集團舉辦「BYE BYE PRESSURE戲劇工作坊」，引領上班族透過肢體活動，練習換位思考、情緒覺察與溝通，裕融表示，未來也將持續結合金融事業、公益夥伴和員工力量，持續擴大社會影響力。
裕融表示，在快速且高壓的工作環境下，上班族的職場壓力往往不僅是工作量與績效目標，也可能源自「無法及時說出口」的情緒與溝通衝突，因此，不僅透過戲劇教育走進校園、陪伴青少年，近期更將專業延伸至企業。

戲劇走進職場 開啟情緒覺察新體驗



長期陪伴中介學生的青藝盟表示，從長期的社會服務和課程經驗中發現，職場壓力和倦怠除與工作量繁重有關，也可能來自人際互動中的情緒張力，例如主管與部屬、不同世代或跨部門間，因立場、經驗和溝通方式不同，對同件事情產生認知落差，而無形中形成壓力。
在近三個小時的工作坊中，青藝盟盟主余浩瑋透過遊戲與戲劇，引導參與者從隨興遊走、觀察周遭人事物，到扮演「藝術家與雕塑家」等肢體活動及角色轉換，讓大家在互動與歡笑中釋放壓力、換位思考與體會覺察。
余浩瑋表示，如同冰山理論，水面上看見的往往是一小部分，真正影響情緒與行為的往往是藏在水面下的內在感受，藉由戲劇互動，正好提供一個重新看見自己、了解彼此的機會。

移動力驅動公益 串聯夥伴共創永續價值



裕融認為，公益合作不只是單向的資源投入，同時透過長期合作與交流，形成永續的正向循環，因此，長期從本業出發，響應裕隆集團「愛的里程數」公益行動，包括共享移動資源支持青藝盟、賦格兒童音樂等 NGO 團體，協助將藝術教育帶進偏遠校園、醫院及療養院所等場域，實踐「移動平權、文化共融」。
2025 年裕融移動服務里程總計逾 12,000 公里，相當於繞行台灣 13 趟，同時，透過「捐服務代替捐車」提升車輛使用效率，並量化服務里程與減碳效益，讓移動服務回應社會需求的同時，也兼顧環境永續。

青藝盟專業回饋 攜手裕融注入友善職場新力

此次青藝盟將戲劇專業帶進企業，是雙方長期合作的延伸，裕融期待青藝盟也將累積的專業帶回企業，形成雙向且持續的交流。
paras_en: Yulon (9941‑TW) recently partnered with the Youth Performing Arts Alliance (referred to as the Youth Arts Alliance) to hold a “BYE BYE PRESSURE” drama workshop at the Yulon Group, guiding office workers through physical activities to practice perspective‑taking, emotional awareness and communication. Yulon said it will continue to combine its financial business, charitable partners and employee power to expand its social impact.

Yulon explained that in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure work environment, employees’ stress often stems not only from workload and performance targets but also from emotions and communication conflicts that they cannot voice in time. Therefore, beyond bringing drama education into schools and accompanying teenagers, the firm is now extending its expertise to corporations.

Drama Enters the Workplace, Opening a New Experience of Emotional Awareness

The Youth Arts Alliance, which has long worked with middle‑school students, says that from its extensive social‑service and curriculum experience it has found that workplace stress and fatigue are not only linked to heavy workloads but also to emotional tension in interpersonal interactions—such as between supervisors and subordinates, across generations or between departments—where differing positions, experiences and communication styles create cognitive gaps that silently generate pressure.

During the three‑hour workshop, Youth Arts Alliance leader Yu Haowei used games and drama to guide participants from casual wandering and observing their surroundings to bodily activities and role‑switching such as playing “artist and sculptor.” Through interaction and laughter, participants released pressure, practiced perspective‑taking and experienced heightened awareness.

Yu Haowei said that, like the iceberg theory, what is visible above the water is only a small part; the true drivers of emotions and behavior lie beneath the surface. Drama interaction provides an opportunity to rediscover oneself and understand others.

Mobility‑Driven Philanthropy Connects Partners to Co‑Create Sustainable Value

Yulon believes that charitable collaboration is not merely a one‑way resource injection; through long‑term cooperation and exchange it creates a sustainable positive cycle. Starting from its core business, Yulon supports the Yulon Group’s “Love Mileage” public‑welfare initiative, sharing mobility resources with the Youth Arts Alliance, Fugue Children’s Music and other NGOs to bring arts education to remote schools, hospitals and care facilities, realizing “mobility equity and cultural inclusion.”

In 2025, Yulon’s mobility services will have logged more than 12,000 kilometres—equivalent to circling Taiwan 13 times. By offering “donate service instead of donating a car,” it improves vehicle utilization, quantifies service mileage and carbon‑reduction benefits, and ensures that mobility services meet social needs while also supporting environmental sustainability.

The Youth Arts Alliance’s professional contribution brings drama into the corporate world as an extension of its long‑term partnership with Yulon. Yulon looks forward to the Alliance’s expertise being brought back into companies, creating a two‑way, ongoing exchange that fosters a friendlier workplace.
