items.title: 康寧再漲顯示玻璃基板價格  京東方、TCL華星與惠科火速跟進 半導體玻璃將開啟AI新篇章？
items.title_en: Corning’s Price Hike Signals Glass Substrate Prices Rising; JD‑Optics, TCL‑Huaxing, and Huike Quickly Follow—Will Semiconductor Glass Open a New Chapter for AI?
paras: 全球顯示器玻璃基板龍頭康寧上周五(11日)宣布，全球日元計價產品漲價15%以上，今年第四季生效，因日元貶值疊加貴金屬、能源、物流成本齊漲，內部已無法消化。
一天前，中國TCL華星率先向下游發出電視面板漲價函，隨後京東方、惠科跟進，三星、LG、索尼均已收到漲價函，主要面板大廠將成本壓力向品牌端傳導的鏈條正式形成。
二級市場迅速反應。 A股玻璃基板概念股周四(17日)直線拉升，沃格光電盤中漲停，三峽新材封板，今(18)日部分獲利回吐，沃格光電跌超4%，三峽新材，京東方、帝爾雷射則逆勢收漲。近五個交易日，沃格光電累計上漲9.44%，京東方三日漲10.82%，漲價預期已提前在股價中定價。
目前面板定價權已明確向中國集中，京東方、TCL華星、惠科平均率在第三季維持90%高位，大尺寸化消耗產能，三家合計佔全球液晶電視面板七成份額。
韓系、台系退出後，本輪漲價函更接近陸廠對價格主動權的主動試探，但最終兌現幅度仍取決於第四季品牌端的採購節奏。
值得區分的是，玻璃基板目前存在兩條截然不同的產業邏輯。顯示領域屬於成熟環節的再定價，漲價是成本驅動的周期性修復；半導體封裝領域則是剛起步的新賽道，驅動力來自AI晶片架構變革。
隨著AI晶片面積增大，有機載板易翹曲、矽中介層成本高的短板暴露，玻璃基板憑藉熱膨脹係數與矽匹配、表面平整度達奈米級、訊號損耗低兩到三個數量級等優勢，成為下一代先進封裝的重要方向。根據機構預估，全球玻璃基板市場將從2024年的90.3億美元增加到2032年的168.1億美元。
產業鏈卡位呈現三層結構：上游原片仍由康寧、肖特、旭硝子主導，中國的凱盛科技、旗濱集團、彩虹股份正向半導體玻璃延伸；中游載板製造投入最重，京東方玻璃基封裝載板試驗線已全自動化通線，做出20層大尺寸樣品，並與康寧簽三年備忘錄，沃格光電建成TGV產線小批量供貨；下游設備環節，帝爾激光TGV激光微孔設備國內市佔約四成，德龍激光、大族數控等跟進。
不過，多數公司的半導體玻璃業務仍處送樣驗證或中試階段，對績效貢獻有限。方向清晰不等於兌現即時，從樣品到訂單再到收入，中間橫亙著客戶認證與良率兩道關卡。市場空間廣闊，但預期通常領先基本面，投資節奏的掌握比單純判斷方向更為關鍵。
paras_en: Corning, the global leader in display glass substrates, announced on Friday (the 11th) that its products priced in Japanese yen will increase by more than 15% effective from the fourth quarter of this year. The yen’s depreciation, coupled with rising precious metals, energy, and logistics costs, has made it impossible for the company to absorb these increases internally.

A day earlier, China’s TCL‑Huaxing was the first to issue a price‑increase notice to downstream customers for TV panels. JD‑Optics and Huike followed suit, and Samsung, LG, and Sony have all received the notices. The major panel manufacturers have now formally passed the cost pressure onto the brand end, completing the chain of price transmission.

The secondary market reacted swiftly. On Thursday (the 17th), A‑share glass substrate concept stocks surged straight up; Woge Optoelectronics hit a daily limit up, while Sanxia New Materials was halted. On the 18th, some profits were taken, with Woge Optoelectronics falling more than 4%, while Sanxia New Materials, JD‑Optics, and Dier Laser rose against the trend. Over the past five trading days, Woge Optoelectronics has risen 9.44% cumulatively, JD‑Optics has risen 10.82% over three days, and the price‑increase expectation has already been priced into the stocks.

Currently, panel pricing power is clearly concentrated in China. JD‑Optics, TCL‑Huaxing, and Huike maintained an average rate of about 90% in the third quarter, consuming large‑scale production capacity. Together, the three companies account for 70% of the global LCD TV panel market share.

After the Korean and Taiwanese players exited, this round of price‑increase notices is closer to a proactive probe by mainland manufacturers into pricing authority, but the ultimate realization will still depend on the procurement rhythm of brands in the fourth quarter.

It is worth distinguishing that glass substrates currently involve two completely different industry logics. In the display field, it is a mature segment undergoing re‑pricing; the price hike is a cyclical cost‑driven adjustment. In semiconductor packaging, it is a nascent new race, driven by AI chip architecture changes.

As AI chips grow larger, the shortcomings of organic substrates—such as warping—and the high cost of silicon interlayers become exposed. Glass substrates, with their low thermal expansion coefficient matching silicon, nanometer‑level surface flatness, and two to three orders of magnitude lower signal loss, become a key direction for next‑generation advanced packaging. According to estimates, the global glass substrate market will grow from $9.03 billion in 2024 to $16.81 billion in 2032.

The industry chain is structured in three layers: upstream raw wafers are still dominated by Corning, Schott, and Kyocera, while Chinese companies like Kaysun Technology, Qibin Group, and Rainbow Co. are extending into semiconductor glass; the mid‑stream substrate manufacturing is the heaviest investment, with JD‑Optics’ glass‑based packaging substrate test line fully automated and capable of producing 20‑layer large‑size samples, and a three‑year memorandum of understanding signed with Corning; Woge Optoelectronics has built a small‑batch TGV production line; in the downstream equipment segment, Dier Laser’s TGV laser micro‑hole equipment holds about 40% of the domestic market, followed by Delong Laser, Auzon CNC, and others.

However, most companies’ semiconductor glass businesses are still in sample verification or pilot testing stages, contributing little to performance. Clear direction does not equal immediate realization; from sample to order to revenue, there are two critical hurdles of customer certification and yield. The market space is vast, but expectations usually precede fundamentals, making the timing of investment more critical than simply judging the direction.

items.title: 真放緩了？Anthropic IPO傳延至11月 AI安全疑慮升溫 估值上看2兆美元
items.title_en: Is the Slowdown Real? Anthropic IPO Delayed to November Amid Rising AI Safety Concerns, Valuation Seen at $2 Trillion
paras: 人工智慧(AI)新創Anthropic的首次公開募股(IPO)時程傳出進一步延後, 原本市場期待最快今年秋季上市, 最新規劃則可能推遲至11月。華爾街日報(WSJ)報導指出, Anthropic正準備在11月進行IPO, 公司希望利用第三季強勁的財務表現向投資人證明業務成長動能, 但近期AI安全疑慮升溫、產業競爭加劇及市場對AI估值的重新評估, 都讓這場備受矚目的IPO面臨更多考驗。
Anthropic今年已秘密提交IPO文件, 原本市場一度預期公司最快可能在9月啟動上市流程, 隨後時程已逐步延後。9月初Reuters曾報導, Anthropic最早可能在10月中開始IPO行銷, 並在11月美國期中選舉前完成上市, 但當時也強調時程仍可能調整。如今最新消息顯示, 上市時間進一步朝11月靠攏。
這場IPO受到高度關注, 原因之一是Anthropic可能尋求高達2兆美元的上市估值, 並可能籌集最高1,000億美元資金。若最終以接近上述規模上市, 將成為史上規模最大的IPO之一, 同時也是公開市場對生成式AI商業模式、資本支出需求及長期獲利能力的一次重要檢驗。
Anthropic近期業務成長速度相當快。公司年化營收規模在2025年底約為90億美元, 今年5月已升至470億美元, 到7月底進一步突破650億美元。這項年化營收數據是將目前銷售速度推算為全年表現, 並不代表公司實際全年營收已經達到相同水準。
根據Reuters此前取得的資料, Anthropic也向銀行與投資人提供2028年營收約1,900億至2,000億美元的預測。這一數字超過今年5月470億美元年化營收的4倍, 顯示公司希望投資人按照未來數年的高速成長潛力來評估其IPO價值。
不過, Anthropic面臨的挑戰也同樣明顯。AI產業近期開始出現對模型開發速度、AI安全及巨額資料中心投資的更多質疑, 投資人對於AI企業是否能在持續增加算力支出的同時擴大利潤率, 也變得更加謹慎。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近期公開呼籲業界放慢AI前沿模型的開發速度, 強調需要提高安全評估與相關防護措施。Amodei的主張引發整個AI產業對「pacing the frontier」的討論, 包括OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與其他科技業領袖也陸續談到AI安全及開發速度問題。
不過, Anthropic所謂的放慢速度並不代表停止AI模型訓練或技術進步。公司仍持續開發新模型、擴大算力及資料中心資源, 因此投資人必須同時評估公司所面臨的AI安全風險與其持續投入資本的需求。
Anthropic與OpenAI之間的競爭也是IPO的重要背景。OpenAI近期推出新一代AI模型, 使市場重新評估Anthropic在模型能力及企業客戶市場的競爭優勢。另一方面, OpenAI執行長Sam Altman近期表示, 公司今年不會上市, 並將繼續處理AI安全與治理相關工作。
相較之下, Anthropic仍在推進上市計畫。公司希望透過公開市場取得更多資金, 以支應未來數年龐大的運算基礎設施需求。這也是此次IPO的重要目的之一, 因為訓練與運行大型AI模型需要大量GPU、資料中心及電力資源。
根據《The Information》取得的投資人簡報資訊, Anthropic截至8月初擁有約1,200億至1,300億美元現金, 但公司也計畫隨著AI基礎設施投資增加而加速消耗現金。這意味著IPO不只是提供早期投資人退出管道, 也可能成為公司未來擴大算力布局的重要融資來源。
Anthropic的資本支出規模已經快速增加。公司第二季營收約從第一季的47億美元增加至超過115億美元, 增幅約2.5倍; 同期間計算基礎設施支出則從34億美元升至56億美元, 增加約65%。公司因此需要向投資人證明, 營收增長速度能夠長期超越算力及資料中心成本的增加。
公司第二季調整後營業利益率也由第一季負13%改善至正的個位數百分比。Anthropic向投資人強調這項「調整後營業利益率」指標, 但該計算方式排除部分非現金成本, 包括股票薪酬等項目。第一季被排除的相關費用超過10億美元, 而公司第一季淨損失超過150億美元, 其中約120億美元來自股權公允價值變動的會計調整。
在客戶端, Anthropic的企業業務也快速擴張。截至2025年底, 過去12個月對Anthropic AI軟體支出至少10萬美元的企業約有1,500家; 到今年第二季結束時, 這一數字已增加至約6,000家, 約為原來的4倍。此外, 超過100家企業每家在12個月內支出超過1,000萬美元, 超過1,000家企業支出超過100萬美元。
Anthropic向投資人展示的企業客戶包括美國國際集團(AIG-US)、Thomson Reuters及Spotify等。公司表示, AI工具已協助部分客戶縮短保險核保時間, 並提高法律服務與其他企業工作的生產力。
但龐大的算力需求也成為Anthropic IPO估值的重要風險。公司今年5月與馬斯克旗下SpaceX達成協議, 未來數年每月支付約12.5億美元取得運算基礎設施。這單一協議的月度支出, 相當於Anthropic第二季所有運算基礎設施支出每月約19億美元的三分之二。
AI基礎設施成本上升的問題並非Anthropic獨有。輝達(NVIDIA, NVDA-US)等AI晶片供應商、雲端服務商及資料中心業者正因AI需求快速擴張而增加資本支出, 但AI企業必須證明這些龐大投資最終可以轉化為足夠的營收及現金流。
另一個風險來自開放權重模型(open-weight models)。市場擔心如果AI模型能力差距縮小, 且部分模型可以低成本甚至免費使用, 企業客戶可能降低對高價商業模型的支出。Anthropic因此需要向IPO投資人證明, 客戶願意持續為Claude等高階模型支付溢價。
市場對Anthropic的估值討論也相當激進。公司今年5月完成650億美元的H輪融資後, 估值達到約9,650億美元, 較今年2月的3,800億美元估值增加逾1倍。若IPO最終按照約2兆美元估值進行, 將意味著公司估值在短短數月內再次大幅提高。

投資銀行與市場參與者目前也開始使用其他高成長科技企業作為估值參考。Reuters報導指出, 市場曾將Cloudflare(NET-US)、Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)及SpaceX等企業視為比較對象。Palantir目前的預估2026年營收本益比概念估值約為53倍營收, Cloudflare及SpaceX則約為41.6倍, 顯示市場給予AI及高成長科技企業相當高的未來成長溢價。
不過, Anthropic此次延後IPO也可能讓公司有更多時間向市場展示第三季財務表現。WSJ報導指出, 公司希望藉由第三季強勁業績凸顯其與OpenAI等競爭對手之間的差異, 並讓投資人更清楚看到現有AI模型帶來的營收能力。
Anthropic同時持續擴大AI應用範圍。Reuters最新報導指出, 公司近期在舊金山灣區建立實體生物實驗室, 並將AI技術延伸至生命科學與藥物開發領域。公司今年也以股票方式收購生技新創Coefficient Bio, 並推出Claude Science等工具, 顯示Anthropic希望將商業模式從程式設計與企業軟體進一步延伸至科學研究。
整體而言, Anthropic將IPO時程推向11月, 正值AI產業進入新的估值檢驗期。公司一方面擁有快速成長的營收、擴大的企業客戶群及接近1兆美元的私募估值, 另一方面則必須面對高昂算力支出、AI安全疑慮、競爭加劇及市場對高估值科技股的重新評估。
如果Anthropic最終按照接近2兆美元估值上市, 這場IPO將不只是公司自身的融資事件, 也將成為公開市場衡量AI商業模式能否支撐超大規模資本支出的重要案例。投資人接下來將密切關注公司第三季營收、營業利潤率、算力支出及現金消耗速度, 以及IPO文件中對2028年營收預測的具體說明。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic’s initial public offering timeline is reportedly being pushed back further; the market had initially hoped for a listing as early as this fall, but the latest plan may delay it until November. The Wall Street Journal reports that Anthropic is preparing for a November IPO, hoping to use strong Q3 financial performance to demonstrate growth momentum to investors, yet heightened AI safety worries, intensified industry competition, and a market re‑assessment of AI valuations are adding new challenges to the highly‑watched offering.

Anthropic secretly filed its IPO paperwork earlier this year, and the market once expected the company could start the listing process as early as September. The timeline has since slipped. Reuters reported in early September that the earliest IPO marketing could begin in mid‑October, with a listing before the U.S. midterm elections in November, but noted the schedule could still change. The newest information shows the launch moving further toward November.

The IPO draws intense attention because Anthropic may seek a valuation of up to $2 trillion and could raise as much as $100 billion. If it goes public at roughly that scale, it would be one of the largest IPOs ever and a key test of the generative‑AI business model, capital‑expenditure needs, and long‑term profitability in the public markets.

Anthropic’s business has been growing very quickly. The company’s annualized revenue is projected to be about $9 billion by the end of 2025; it rose to $4.7 billion in May of this year and broke $6.5 billion by the end of July. These figures annualize the current sales pace and do not reflect actual full‑year revenue to date.

According to data previously obtained by Reuters, Anthropic also gave banks and investors a revenue forecast of roughly $190 billion to $200 billion for 2028. That amount is more than four times the $4.7 billion annualized revenue reported in May, indicating the company wants investors to value the IPO based on high‑growth potential over the next several years.

Nevertheless, Anthropic faces clear challenges. The AI sector is seeing more scrutiny over model‑development speed, AI safety, and massive data‑center spending, and investors are becoming more cautious about whether AI firms can expand profit margins while continuously increasing compute costs.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently called on the industry to slow the pace of frontier‑model development, emphasizing the need for stronger safety assessments and protective measures. Amodei’s stance sparked a broader “pacing the frontier” debate across the AI field, with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and other tech leaders also weighing in on safety and development‑speed issues.

However, Anthropic’s call to slow down does not mean halting AI model training or technological progress. The company continues to develop new models and expand compute and data‑center capacity, so investors must assess both the AI‑safety risks and the capital required for ongoing investment.

Competition with OpenAI is another key backdrop for the IPO. OpenAI’s recent launch of a next‑generation model has prompted the market to re‑evaluate Anthropic’s competitive edge in model capability and enterprise customers. Meanwhile, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has said the company will not go public this year and will keep focusing on AI safety and governance.

In contrast, Anthropic is still moving ahead with its listing plan. The firm hopes to tap public‑market capital to fund the massive compute infrastructure it will need in the coming years. This financing need is a core purpose of the IPO, as training and running large AI models requires extensive GPUs, data‑center space, and power.

According to investor‑presentation material obtained by The Information, Anthropic held roughly $120 billion to $130 billion in cash as of early August, but plans to burn cash faster as AI‑infrastructure spending ramps up. This means the IPO is not only an exit route for early investors but could also become a major source of funding for expanding its compute footprint.

Anthropic’s capital‑expenditure bill is rising rapidly. Q2 revenue jumped from $4.7 billion in Q1 to over $11.5 billion, a 2.5‑fold increase; during the same period, infrastructure spending rose from $3.4 billion to $5.6 billion, about a 65% jump. The company therefore must show investors that revenue growth can sustainably outpace the rising costs of compute and data‑center capacity.

Adjusted operating margin improved from a negative 13% in Q1 to a positive single‑digit percentage in Q2. Anthropic highlights this “adjusted operating margin” metric to investors, but the calculation excludes certain non‑cash items such as stock‑based compensation. More than $1 billion of such expenses were excluded in Q1, and the quarter’s net loss exceeded $15 billion, about $12 billion of which stemmed from accounting adjustments to equity fair‑value changes.

On the customer side, Anthropic’s enterprise business is expanding fast. By the end of 2025, roughly 1,500 companies had spent at least $100,000 on Anthropic AI software in the prior 12 months; that number grew to about 6,000 by the end of Q2 this year, roughly four times the earlier count. Over 100 firms spent more than $10 million each in a year, and more than 1,000 firms spent over $1 million.

Anthropic cites enterprise customers such as AIG‑US, Thomson Reuters and Spotify. The company says its AI tools have helped some clients shorten insurance underwriting cycles and boost productivity in legal services and other corporate functions.

But the massive compute demand also represents a key valuation risk for the IPO. In May, Anthropic struck a deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX to pay roughly $1.25 billion per month for compute infrastructure over the next several years. That monthly outlay equals about two‑thirds of Anthropic’s total Q2 compute‑infrastructure spend of roughly $1.9 billion per month.

Rising AI‑infrastructure costs are not unique to Anthropic. Chip makers such as NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), cloud providers and data‑center operators are all increasing capex to meet exploding AI demand, but AI firms must prove that these huge investments can eventually translate into sufficient revenue and cash flow.

Another risk comes from open‑weight models. The market worries that if the performance gap between AI models narrows and some models become low‑cost or free, enterprise customers may cut spending on premium commercial models. Anthropic therefore needs to convince IPO investors that customers will continue to pay a premium for high‑end models like Claude.

Valuation discussions around Anthropic are extremely aggressive. After a $65 billion Series H round in May, the company’s valuation rose to about $965 billion, more than double the $380 billion valuation in February. If the IPO proceeds at roughly a $2 trillion valuation, the company’s worth would have surged again within just a few months.

Investment banks and market participants are already using other high‑growth tech firms as comparables. Reuters notes that the market has looked at companies such as Cloudflare (NET‑US), Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US) and SpaceX. Palantir’s projected 2026 revenue‑multiple valuation is about 53× revenue, while Cloudflare and SpaceX are around 41.6×, indicating a high growth premium for AI and fast‑growth tech stocks.

Nonetheless, the delayed IPO may give Anthropic more time to showcase its Q3 financial performance. The WSJ reports the company hopes strong Q3 results will highlight its differentiation from rivals like OpenAI and give investors a clearer view of the revenue potential of its existing AI models.

Anthropic is also expanding the scope of its AI applications. Reuters reports the firm recently opened a physical biology lab in the San Francisco Bay Area and is extending AI into life‑science and drug‑development fields. This year it also acquired biotech startup Coefficient Bio via stock and launched Claude Science, signaling a push to move from software and enterprise tools into scientific research.

Overall, moving the IPO timeline to November comes as the AI industry enters a new valuation‑testing phase. Anthropic boasts rapid revenue growth, an expanding enterprise customer base and a near‑$1 trillion private‑market valuation, but it must also contend with hefty compute spend, AI‑safety concerns, intensifying competition and a market re‑evaluating lofty tech‑stock valuations.

If Anthropic ultimately lists at a valuation close to $2 trillion, the IPO will be more than a financing event for the company; it will serve as a critical case study for whether AI business models can sustain massive capital outlays in the public markets. Investors will closely monitor Q3 revenue, operating‑margin trends, compute spend, cash‑burn rate and the specific 2028 revenue guidance disclosed in the IPO filing.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 爆量走升收31.808元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Hot Money Returns, Stocks and Exchange Rate Rise, Volume Surges, Closing at 31.808
paras: 美國升息 1 碼，不確定因素消除，在熱錢回流下，台北股匯今 (18) 日連袂走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.5 角，終場升幅收斂，收在 31.808 元，升值 7.3 分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值爆出 39.9 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天以 31.86 元開盤後，在熱錢狂湧下，一度升抵 31.722 元，但日本央行決議升息，日元應聲走貶，加上央行全力防守，使得新台幣升幅明顯收斂，終場收在 31.808 元，升值 7.3 分，匯價連二升。
本周受到升息預期影響，美元表現強勢，新台幣兌美元本周累計貶值 1.7 角、貶幅 0.53%，周線連三黑。
在美股強力反彈下，台股今天持續走揚，台積電、聯發科、聯電、日月光投控等電子權值股普遍走高，大盤終場勁揚 892.75 點，收在 47180.75 點，成功站上 4 萬 7，外資買超 869 億元，上市公司總市值回升至 154.32 兆元。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.1%，亞幣互有升貶，日元重挫 1.15%，新台幣升值 0.23%， 人民幣亦升值 0.16%，韓元則小升 0.04%。
paras_en: U.S. rate hikes by one percentage point removed uncertainties, and with hot‑money inflows, Taipei’s stock and foreign‑exchange markets both rose on the 18th. The New Taiwan dollar briefly surged 0.15 NTD per USD before the gain narrowed, closing at 31.808 NTD, up 0.073 NTD, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai FX markets exploded to $3.99 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.86 per USD and, amid a flood of hot money, climbed to 31.722. However, the Bank of Japan’s decision to raise rates caused the yen to depreciate, and the central bank’s vigorous defense curbed the NT$’s rise. It finished at 31.808 NTD, up 0.073 NTD, marking a second consecutive session of appreciation.
This week, expectations of further rate hikes kept the dollar strong. The New Taiwan dollar depreciated against the USD by 0.17 NTD (0.53%) for the week, delivering a third straight weekly decline.

With a strong rebound in U.S. equities, Taiwan’s market kept climbing today. Major chip stocks such as TSMC, MediaTek, UMC and ASE Technology Holding all rose, and the index surged 892.75 points to close at 47,180.75, breaking the 47,000 level. Foreign investors net bought NT$86.9 billion, and the total market capitalization of listed companies recovered to NT$154.32 trillion.

Observing major Asian currencies today, central‑bank data show the U.S. dollar index up 0.1%. Asian currencies were mixed: the yen fell 1.15%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.23%, the Chinese yuan gained 0.16%, and the Korean won edged up 0.04%.

items.title: 日銀總裁的「鷹派立場」未讓市場理解及接受 日元跌勢加劇
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Governor's Hawkish Stance Not Understood or Accepted by Market, Yen Decline Accelerates
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周五(18日)在記者會上，傳達出對於升息更為積極的鷹派姿態，然而日元不僅未能止跌，跌勢反倒進一步擴大。分析師指出，主因是植田的說法未讓投資者理解及滿意。
日本外匯市場周五傍晚，日元兌美元匯率一度跌至157區間後段，較紐約市場收盤時的跌幅達1.2%。日本央行在貨幣政策會議上將政策利率從之前的1%上調至1.25%，植田則重申繼續升息立場。

短期承壓：政策訊息混淆

Reed Capital 投資總監 Gerald Gan 表示，儘管植田試圖平息市場情緒，但他仍維持短期內日元將持續疲軟的看法，並強調日銀與美國聯準會(Fed)在前瞻指引上的分歧，正成為影響日元穩定的主要疑慮。
富國銀行(Wells Fargo)亞太區策略負責人 Chidu Narayana 指出，植田的鷹派態度不足以支持市場原本過於激進的期待，在缺乏明確鷹派信號與美元反彈下，美元兌日元匯率將維持高位。
Stonex Financial 利率主管 Shriya Samarth 認為，日銀傳遞的訊息相當混淆，既承認政策優先順序改變，又不願承諾面對通膨上行風險，難以被市場認定為足夠鷹派。T&D 資產管理首席策略師Hiroshi Namioka補充，市場難解讀植田的發言，導致日元短暫走強後再度重回貶勢。

結構性壓力與市場干預風險

Pictet Asset Management Japan 投資策略部長田中純平分析，植田宣示「政策營運階段改變」，雖有助於消除市場對日銀落後於曲線的疑慮，但受制於日元面臨的結構性下行壓力，加上市場預期的日美升息步調差異有限，僅憑本次會議結果難以觸發持續性的日元升值行情。
此外，他提醒連休期間交易清淡，投資人仍需戒備日美政府進行協調干預的可能性，預期美元兌日元將持續劇烈波動且缺乏明確方向。

部分分析師看好日元中長期走升

不過，部分分析師持較為樂觀的態度。SMBC 信託銀行投資調查部長山口真弘認為，植田成功化解了記者會可能引發日元急跌的風險，且日銀的基本立場並未改變，市場仍維持每3個月升息一次(如今年 12 月)的預期，因此不認為日元會陷入長期走貶趨勢。
State Street Investment Management 資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo強調，市場不應過度解讀兩位審議委員的反對票，美元兌日元在 160 附近仍宜採取逢高賣出策略。他預測，隨著日銀政策正常化帶動國內殖利率上升、日本資產吸引機構資金回流，以及 AI 相關投資增加等三大結構性因素，日元中長期走勢將逐漸獲得支撐。
paras_en: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday (the 18th) conveyed a more aggressive hawkish stance toward rate hikes at a press conference, yet the yen not only failed to stop falling, its decline actually widened. Analysts said the main reason was that Ueda's remarks did not resonate with or satisfy investors.

In the Japanese foreign‑exchange market on Friday evening, the yen slipped to the lower end of the 157 range against the dollar, a 1.2% drop from the New York close. The BOJ raised its policy rate from 1.0% to 1.25% at its monetary‑policy meeting, and Ueda reiterated the commitment to continue raising rates.

Short‑term pressure: mixed policy signals
Gerald Gan, Investment Director at Reed Capital, said that despite Ueda’s attempt to calm market sentiment, he still expects the yen to remain weak in the short run and highlighted the growing divergence between the BOJ and the U.S. Federal Reserve on forward guidance as a key concern for yen stability.

Chidu Narayana, Head of Asia‑Pacific Strategy at Wells Fargo, noted that Ueda’s hawkish tone was insufficient to meet the market’s overly aggressive expectations, and without a clear hawkish signal and a dollar rebound, the dollar‑yen pair is likely to stay elevated.

Shriya Samarth, Head of Rates at Stonex Financial, said the BOJ’s messaging was quite confusing – it acknowledged a shift in policy priorities but was unwilling to commit to tackling upside inflation risks, making it hard for the market to view the stance as sufficiently hawkish. Hiroshi Namioka, Chief Strategist at T&D Asset Management, added that the market struggled to interpret Ueda’s comments, causing a brief yen rally that quickly reverted to depreciation.

Structural pressure and intervention risk
Junpei Tanaka, Head of Investment Strategy for Japan at Pictet Asset Management, analyzed that Ueda’s declaration of a “change in the policy operating phase” helps allay concerns that the BOJ is lagging behind the yield curve, but the yen faces structural downward pressure and the expected gap between Japan and U.S. rate‑hiking paths is limited, so the meeting outcome alone is unlikely to trigger a sustained yen appreciation rally.

He also warned that trading is thin over the holiday period and investors should remain vigilant about the possibility of coordinated intervention by Japanese and U.S. authorities, expecting the dollar‑yen to continue swinging wildly with no clear direction.

Some analysts are bullish on the yen over the medium to long term
Nevertheless, a few analysts are more optimistic. Masahiro Yamaguchi, Head of Investment Research at SMBC Trust Bank, believes Ueda successfully defused the risk of a sharp yen drop that could have arisen from the press conference, and that the BOJ’s fundamental stance remains unchanged. The market still expects a rate hike every three months (e.g., in December), so he does not see the yen entering a long‑term downtrend.

Masahiko Loo, Senior Fixed‑Income Strategist at State Street Investment Management, stressed that the market should not over‑interpret the dissenting votes of two board members. He recommends selling on rallies near the 160 level for the dollar‑yen. He forecasts that as BOJ policy normalises, domestic yields rise, Japanese assets attract institutional inflows, and AI‑related investments grow, three structural factors will gradually support the yen’s medium‑ to long‑term trajectory.

items.title: 升息過後為何日元摔、日股漲？解析日銀決策被解讀不夠鷹派的三大關鍵
paras: 日本銀行(央行，BOJ)周五(18日)將升息1碼(25個基點)至1.25%，利率創1995年以來最高，且升息間隔從之前的六個月縮短為三個月。儘管升息步調加快，日本金融市場卻出現違反直覺的走勢：日元走弱、10年期日本公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數上漲。
分析師指出，日銀理事會表決出現兩張反對升息票，加上本次升息並未同步公布最新經濟展望，都讓市場解讀日銀不夠鷹派。
目前市場預期，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息，但對利率最終將升至多高卻看法不一。
升息通常會帶動一國貨幣上揚、推升債券殖利率，並對股市造成壓力，但日本的貨幣、債券殖利率與股市周五卻出現完全相反的走勢。截稿前，日元跌破157日元兌1美元，10年期日本政府公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數收盤上漲1.4%。

升息決策7票對2票 市場解讀不夠鷹派

專家指出，日銀理事會出現分歧，是市場出現非典型反應的原因，因為這顯示日本央行可能不會採取過於鷹派的立場。
日本銀行三井住友銀行(SMBC)首席外匯策略師Hirofumi Suzuki說：「兩票反對升息、主張維持利率不變，令人感到意外。」
本次升息決策以七票對兩票通過，理事淺田統一郎(Toichiro Asada)與佐藤綾野(Ayano Sato)投下反對票，他們是由首相高市早苗今年稍早任命、被視為恢復通膨派的人馬。
佐藤綾野指出，由於核心通膨率低於2%，經濟情勢可能還不夠強勁，因此主張維持利率不變。日本8月核心通膨率微降至1.7%，低於7月的1.8%。
淺田統一郎也表示，與先前相比，目前經濟與物價發展似乎沒有大幅加速。

未同步更新經濟展望

道富投資管理公司(State Street Investment Management)資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo指出，此次升息未同步公布更新版的經濟展望報告，也是市場反直覺回應的原因之一，因為這限制了日銀透過調整預測來強化鷹派訊息的能力。
牛津經濟學(Oxford Economics)日本經濟主管Shigeto Nagai認同這項看法，他表示，兩名反對升息的理事傳遞的訊號是，高市早苗並未確定接受美國要求日本加快升息的主張。
路透周五報導，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)5月與日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)會面時，曾強調日銀需要提高利率。
Nagai進一步補充說：「其次，如果我們觀察聲明，所有措辭與語氣幾乎都與7月公布的季度展望報告相同，因此語氣不像金融市場原本期待的那麼鷹派。」

利率還能升多少？

專家目前認為，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息。
道富的Loo表示，他預期日銀總裁植田和男將強調，未來每一次政策會議都仍然「有可能升息」。他說：「如今爭論的已經不是日銀是否升息，而是利率最終會升到多高。」
日銀表示，隨著經濟與物價情勢發展，將持續調升利率。不過，日銀也承認，中東衝突推升油價，可能導致經濟成長放緩。
EFG International經濟學家Sam Jochim表示，隨著潛在通膨率接近2%，利率可能大約每三個月調升一次。他預期，2027年的終點利率、也就是利率可能達到的峰值，將落在1.75%至2%之間。
BOJ並未預測終點利率，而是持續表示將「適當」執行貨幣政策，以讓潛在通膨率穩定在約2%的目標。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)亞太區經濟主管Stefan Angrick預期，日銀可能在今年底至明年初再度升息，但需求帶動的通膨疲弱，加上實質薪資成長令人失望，將限縮後續的升息幅度。

items.title: 不排除更大幅度或連續升息！日本央行總裁：貨幣政策進入「新階段」
items.title_en: BOJ Governor Says Monetary Policy Has Entered a "New Phase"; Larger or Consecutive Rate Hikes Not Ruled Out
paras: 日本央行(BOJ)今(18)日結束兩天會議，決定把無擔保隔夜拆款利率目標由1%上調1碼至1.25%，為1995年以來最高水準，該決議以7票贊成、2票反對通過，距6月升息僅時隔三個月，是1990年來間隔最短的連續升息。
BOJ總裁植田和男在會後記者會上表示，基礎通膨率逐步接近2%，日本貨幣政策「已進入新階段」，未來升息節奏與幅度將按物價形勢逐次判斷，不設定「每三個月加一次」等固定路徑。若基礎通膨有持續超過2%的風險，不排除更大幅度或連續升息，但終端利率與中性利率目前難精確界定，將在實際緊縮中慢慢校準。
根據BOJ聲明，物價存在向上偏離2%目標的風險，將繼續依經濟、物價與金融情勢調整寬鬆程度，制定政策時重點看中東局勢、AI需求與匯率傳導。
植田和男指出，中東危機已帶動第二輪物價上漲，油價、進口成本與企業轉價壓力均需警惕，避免通膨明顯超標後被迫劇烈緊縮。
8月數據呈「表面放緩、底層仍緊」。根據日本總務省公布的CPI數據，8月年增率1.9%，剔除鮮食核心CPI年增1.7%、低於7月1.8%，剔除鮮食與能源的核心指標漲1.9%，而政府能源等補貼壓低8月CPI約0.62個百分點。同期，企業物價指數年增7.6%，有色金屬、資通設備、石油煤炭分別大漲，日元計價進口物價年增24.8%，顯示上游成本正往終端傳導。
2張反對票也反映BOJ內部分歧。淺田統一郎認為，核心通膨率仍低於2%，經濟尚不足以支持再度升息；佐藤綾野主張觀察6月升息效果，不急於9月行動。兩人反對及植田「未給下次明確時間表」的事實，削弱市場對BOJ快速連續升息的預期。
金融市場呈「買預期、賣事實」。BOJ決議出爐後，日元兌美元一度貶破157，日本10年期國債殖利率回落，日經225收漲約1.4%。通常，升息會支撐本國貨幣與長債利率，但本次因反對票、缺乏更鷹前瞻，加上美債與Fed升息預期壓住美日利差，日元與日債未獲明顯提振。
分析人士指出，後續焦點轉向今年內BOJ是否再次升息、企業夏季獎金與2027年春鬥薪情能否讓基礎通膨穩住2%；若油價、日元貶值與批發物價繼續向上，BOJ即便內部分歧，仍可能維持每季度評估、漸進推高政策利率。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) concluded its two‑day meeting today (the 18th), raising the uncollateralised overnight call rate target from 1.0% to 1.25% – a 0.25‑percentage‑point increase and the highest level since 1995. The decision passed 7‑to‑2, marking the shortest interval between consecutive hikes since 1990, just three months after the June increase.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told reporters after the meeting that the underlying inflation rate is gradually approaching 2% and that Japan’s monetary policy "has entered a new phase." Future rate‑hike timing and magnitude will be judged case‑by‑case based on price developments, with no preset path such as "every three months." If the core inflation risk of staying above 2% persists, larger or back‑to‑back hikes are not ruled out, although the terminal and neutral rates are currently hard to pin down and will be calibrated gradually as tightening proceeds.

According to the BOJ statement, price pressures pose a risk of deviating upward from the 2% target, and the bank will continue to adjust the degree of easing in line with economic, price and financial conditions, paying particular attention to the Middle‑East situation, AI demand and exchange‑rate transmission when formulating policy.

Ueda noted that the Middle‑East crisis has sparked a second round of price increases, with oil prices, import costs and corporate pass‑through pressures all requiring vigilance to avoid a scenario where inflation clearly overshoots the target and forces a sharp tightening.

August data showed a "surface slowdown but underlying tightness." Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications CPI data showed an annual increase of 1.9% in August, with core CPI (excluding fresh food) up 1.7% year‑on‑year, down from 1.8% in July. Core CPI excluding fresh food and energy rose 1.9%, while government energy subsidies trimmed the August CPI by about 0.62 percentage points. In the same period, the corporate goods price index rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, with large jumps in non‑ferrous metals, ICT equipment and oil‑coal; import prices priced in yen surged 24.8% year‑on‑year, indicating upstream cost pressures are passing through to the end‑user.

The two dissenting votes also reflected internal divisions at the BOJ. Ichiro Asada argued that core inflation remains below 2% and the economy is not strong enough to support another hike; Ayano Sato advocated waiting to see the effect of the June hike and said there was no rush to act in September. Their opposition, together with Ueda’s lack of a clear timetable for the next move, weakened market expectations of rapid consecutive hikes.

Financial markets displayed a "buy the expectation, sell the fact" pattern. After the BOJ decision, the yen briefly fell past ¥157 per dollar, 10‑year Japanese government bond yields retreated, and the Nikkei 225 rose about 1.4%. Typically, a rate hike supports the domestic currency and long‑term bond yields, but this time the dissenting votes, the absence of a more hawkish outlook, and U.S. Treasury and Fed rate‑hike expectations compressing the yen‑U.S. yield spread kept the yen and JGBs from receiving a clear boost.

Analysts said the next focus will be whether the BOJ will hike again within the year, corporate summer bonuses and whether 2027 spring‑time wage negotiations can keep core inflation anchored at 2%. If oil prices, yen depreciation and wholesale prices keep rising, the BOJ may still move forward with quarterly assessments and incremental policy‑rate increases despite internal disagreements.

items.title: 「川習會」前夕人民幣強勢突破6.70關卡 創逾4年新高
items.title_en: Ahead of the ‘Xi‑Trump Meeting’, the RMB Breaks Through the 6.70 Barrier, Reaching a Four‑Year High
paras: 在美中元首即將會面及美國聯準會宣布升息的背景下，在岸與離岸人民幣對美元匯率周五(18日)雙雙升破 6.70 關卡，創下逾4年來新高。
離岸人民幣對美元周五亞市盤中最高升至 6.6935 至 6.6953，在岸人民幣即期匯率升破 6.70 關卡，觸及 6.6954 至 6.6975。中國人民銀行將人民幣對美元中間價設為 6.7521，連續第八個交易日上調，創近兩年最長連升紀錄，釋放明確的穩匯率訊號。今年以來，在岸與離岸人民幣對美元累計升值均已超過 4%。
在國際市場方面，美國聯準會剛決議升息一碼至 4%，點陣圖顯示年內可能再升息，帶動美元指數一度衝高。然而，儘管中國 8 月新增貸款遠低於預期、信用需求偏弱，人民幣依然展現抗跌韌性。
市場分析指出，6.70 為重要技術與心理關卡。人行引導匯率偏強，有助於穩定資金預期並緩解資本外流壓力。
此外，中國國家主席習近平預計於 9 月 24 日與美國總統川普會面，分析認為北京在峰會前容許人民幣升值，能降低美方對弱勢匯率的指控，釋放談判善意。
針對本輪升值行情，東方金誠首席宏觀分析師王青指出，走強主因包含聯準會升息效應釋放後美元指數回落，以及中間價偏強調整。王青表示，中國出口持續高增長與經濟穩中有進為匯率築牢基本面。在「宏觀審慎+微觀監管」框架下，不必過度高估升息衝擊，短期內人民幣預計將維持穩中偏強格局。
另一方面，華福證券首席經濟學家管濤則提醒市場應理性看待升值。管濤表示，雖然短期利多因素占優，但升值的宏觀緊縮效應可能干擾市場情緒。長期來看，「雙向波動」將是常態，不宜將升值過度解讀為資產重估，不宜對匯率做過多的價值判斷。
paras_en: Against the backdrop of an upcoming meeting between the U.S. and Chinese heads of state and the Federal Reserve’s rate‑hike announcement, both on‑shore and off‑shore RMB‑USD rates on Friday the 18th surged past the 6.70 mark, setting a new high not seen in over four years.

The offshore RMB rose to a peak of 6.6935‑6.6953 against the dollar during Friday’s Asian session, while the on‑shore spot rate broke the 6.70 barrier, reaching 6.6954‑6.6975. The People’s Bank of China set the RMB‑USD central parity at 6.7521, marking the eighth consecutive trading day of an upward adjustment and the longest streak in nearly two years, sending a clear signal of rate stability. Since the start of the year, both on‑shore and offshore RMB have appreciated by more than 4% against the dollar.

In international markets, the Fed just voted to raise rates by one basis point to 4%, and the dot‑plot suggests another hike could come later this year, briefly pushing the U.S. dollar index higher. Nevertheless, despite August’s new‑loan growth falling well short of expectations and credit demand remaining weak, the RMB has shown resilience against declines.
Analysts note that 6.70 is a key technical and psychological level. The PBOC’s guidance toward a stronger exchange rate helps stabilize funding expectations and eases pressure from capital outflows.

Moreover, Chinese President Xi Jinping is slated to meet U.S. President Donald Trump on September 24. Analysts believe that allowing the RMB to appreciate before the summit can reduce U.S. accusations of a weak currency and signal goodwill in the negotiations.

Commenting on the recent appreciation, Wang Qing, chief macro analyst at Dongfang Jincheng, said the main drivers are the Fed‑rate‑hike effect that has pulled the dollar index back and the relatively strong central parity adjustment. Wang added that China’s continued strong export growth and a stable‑yet‑improving economy provide a solid fundamentals foundation for the currency. Under a “macro‑prudent plus micro‑regulation” framework, the rate‑hike impact should not be over‑estimated, and the RMB is expected to remain stable‑to‑strong in the short term.

On the other hand, Guan Tao, chief economist at Huafu Securities, cautioned that the market should view the appreciation rationally. Guan said that although short‑term bullish factors dominate, the macro‑tightening effect of an appreciating currency could affect market sentiment. In the long run, “two‑way volatility” will be the norm, and the appreciation should not be over‑interpreted as an asset revaluation nor should the exchange rate be subject to excessive value judgments.

隨後美國商務部公布8月房屋開工跌2.6%至經季節調整年率為127.5萬戶及建築許可減2.7%至年率達139.4萬戶均遜於預期，打擊美元兌日圓至155.32低點，但美國上周初請失業金人數意外降至19.6萬人及費城聯邦儲備銀行9月製造業指數為正37.8優於預估值，而且8月全美房地產經紀人協會(NAR)成屋待完成銷售指數升0.9%至71.2，扶助美元兌日圓反彈。今日市場關注BOJ會議決議及BOJ總裁植田和男會後新聞發布會是否就未來政策走向發出鷹派信號。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於155.40-60，阻力於156.50-70。
◆EUR/USD
美國料進一步升息推升美元，但昨日紐西蘭公布第二季國內生產總值(GDP)分別較前季與上年同期增長0.2%及2.6%優於預期，料緩解紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)的擔憂，而且國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)認為今年通貨膨脹率保持較高水平及質疑金融環境是否足夠緊縮，澳洲央行(RBA)可能要再加息，緩和澳幣和紐元跌勢，帶動歐元兌美元脫離1.1450低點。

隨著德國機械設備製造聯合會(VDMA)預計今年該行業連續第四年萎縮，下調對該行業表現持平的預測，但明年應可轉折，並據歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員雷恩稱，歐元區未出現明確第二輪通貨膨脹效應，ECB有可行工具確保貨幣政策順利傳導，而且歐元區8月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)較去年同期降至3.2%，但如預期較前月漲0.4%，提振歐元兌美元至1.1497高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1480-1.150，支撐於1.1400-20。
◆GBP/USD

週四英國央行(BOE)貨幣政策委員會(MPC)再次以6比3的投票結果維持利率在3.75%不變，同時將暫停向市場出售英國公債，更預測英國通貨膨脹率將在明年初突破4%，BOE總裁貝利則明確警告，若中東衝突長期持續，可能需要收緊貨幣政策，激勵英鎊兌美元反彈至1.3406高點，但FED鷹派加息的前景推升美元，打壓英鎊兌美元下挫\1.3333低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3360-80，支撐於1.3260-80。

U.S. August retail sales were strong and import prices surged, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) raised rates by 25 basis points as expected. The Fed also signaled at least one more hike before December and a pause next year, while rate‑futures show about a 90% chance of another 25‑bp increase by year‑end, spurring a sharp rise in the dollar. Market focus shifted to Friday’s Bank of Japan (BOJ) decision, with most expecting a rate hike to a 31‑year high of 1.25% and a signal that borrowing costs will stay elevated. On Thursday, Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said Japan will keep close communication with the United States to maintain stable yen movements. Prime Minister Kishida also reshuffled the cabinet, retaining many key ministers to solidify political support amid market turbulence and to push forward her flagship spending plan. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki stayed on to ensure continuity in Japan’s exchange‑rate policy, pledging a firm response to excessive yen volatility. Economy Minister Shunichi Suzuki also remained, supporting the re‑inflation policy, but he said there will be no reckless fiscal expansion, providing support for the yen. The dollar‑yen fell from a high of 156.31.

Later, the U.S. Commerce Department reported that August housing starts dropped 2.6% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.275 million units and building permits fell 2.7% to an annual rate of 1.394 million, both missing expectations. This pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 155.32. However, initial jobless claims unexpectedly fell to 196,000 and the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia’s September manufacturing index came in at a positive 37.8, beating forecasts. The National Association of Realtors’ August existing‑home‑sales‑to‑pending‑sales index rose 0.9% to 71.2, helping the dollar‑yen rebound. Today’s market will watch the BOJ’s policy decision and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda’s post‑meeting press conference signals a hawkish outlook. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 155.40‑155.60 and face resistance near 156.50‑156.70.
EUR/USD

The United States is expected to keep raising rates, which should lift the dollar, but New Zealand yesterday released Q2 GDP figures showing 0.2% growth versus the previous quarter and 2.6% year‑over‑year, both ahead of expectations. This should ease concerns at the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ). Meanwhile, the IMF warned that inflation will stay high this year and questioned whether the financial environment is tight enough, suggesting the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may need another hike, which could soften the recent declines in the Australian and New Zealand dollars and push the euro‑dollar pair away from the 1.1450 low.

Germany’s VDMA now expects the machinery sector to contract for the fourth consecutive year, lowering its outlook to flat performance but seeing a turnaround possible next year. ECB Governing Council member Robert Holzmann said the euro area has not yet shown a clear second‑round inflation effect and that the ECB has tools to ensure smooth policy transmission. August’s harmonised CPI fell to 3.2% year‑on‑year, though it rose 0.4% from the previous month as expected, lifting the euro‑dollar to a high of 1.1497. The euro‑dollar is projected to face resistance at 1.1480‑1.1500 and support at 1.1400‑1.1420.
GBP/USD

On Thursday the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee voted 6‑3 to keep rates at 3.75% and to pause the sale of gilts. It also forecast that UK inflation will break the 4% mark in early next year. BOE Governor Andrew Bailey warned that a prolonged Middle‑East conflict could force tighter policy, which helped the pound rally to a high of 1.3406 against the dollar. However, the Fed’s hawkish outlook lifted the dollar and pushed the pound down to a low of 1.3333. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to face resistance at 1.3360‑1.3380 and support at 1.3260‑1.3280.
